publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Large-scale photovoltaic power plants are an effective way to realize the central use of solar energies. The DC step-up collection system has the advantages of high stability and efficiency over the traditional AC step-up collection system. This paper analyzes the topology features of existing DC collection systems. The LPPP-DSCS topologies can be divided into two types: single-stage DC/DC converter structure and two-stage DC/DC converter structure. Photovoltaic string topologies, converter topologies, and their combinations determine the LPPP-DSCS topology. A variety of DC collection systems topological structures are proposed including photovoltaic string topology, converter topology, and the combination structure of photovoltaic power plants. According to the different application scenarios, the corresponding suitable topological structures is presented. The proposed design and topology are of well-referred to the large scale photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: FRT dynamic analysis and stability enhancement of MMC-HVDC connected offshore wind farms employing voltage drop control
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Voltage drop method is generally accepted for the fault ride-through (FRT) control of VSC-HVDC connected offshore wind farms. However, it may lead to the dc-link voltage fluctuation and further deteriorate the dynamic stability. This paper reveals above phenomenon for the first time and analyses its coupling mechanism. The instantaneous power of the MMC arm and phase unit are derived and it indicates that the dc current component induced by the offshore voltage drop leads to the fundamental-frequency ripple in the dc-link voltage. Two available internal control schemes are presented for MMC stations to improve the FRT dynamic stability by suppressing the dc-link fluctuation. Simulation results show that the presented energy-based method can suppress the fluctuation of dc-link voltage effectively and improve the stability of offshore grid through the FRT period.

articleTitle: Study on moisture penetration of heating composite insulator
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Composite insulator is widely used in UHV transmission lines in coastal and polluted areas for its excellent anti-pollution flashover performance, high strength, easy installation and many other advantages. In recent years, the heating problem of composite insulators in high temperature and humidity area have been widely concerned and the moisture penetration is the key factor to the temperature rise. In this paper, the heating phenomenon of composite insulator is classified by infrared temperature measurement and the way of moisture penetration is studied by sample dissection and water absorption test. The test results show that the heating of composite insulator can be divided into two types: sectional heating and end heating. Sectional heating is caused by internal partial discharge on account of seal failure of end fittings and bonding failure of sheath and mandrel. The end heating is caused by the increase of polarization loss of sheath material after moisture penetration. The difference of pore structure and surface aging of the sheath material are the key factors leading to the change of hygroscopicity.

articleTitle: Performance comparison active disturbance rejection control tuned by particle swarm optimization technique and gravitational search algorithm based load frequency control
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, ADRC adjusted by the Gravitational Search Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization Technique for determination of the optimal value for parameters in load frequency control of a single-area power system. A single-area non-reheat thermal system considered to design the ADRC controller tuning PSO and GSA. The performance is comparing ADRC-GSA, ADRC-PSO controllers, and classic ADRC controller. The simulation outcomes demonstrate that the ADRC approach using the GSA algorithm provides a better overshoot and less settling time compared to those of the ADRC controller and ADRC-PSO.

articleTitle: Monitoring system of transmission corridor based on image processing technology
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Transmission corridor, which is the key link of the transmission network, is composed of some high voltage and capacity transmission lines. With the increase of outside destroy risk points and transmission lines, the traditional prevention work of outside destroy of transmission line needs more human and material resources. This paper analyzed outside destroy failures of Zhejiang grid. Research on panoramic monitoring of transmission line developed by state grid Zhejiang power company was introduced.

articleTitle: Line protection of multi voltage AC / DC distribution system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The continuous breakthrough of various distributed energy technologies and the corresponding installed capacity are also increasing rapidly, which has caused great pressure on the traditional AC distribution network. DC distribution system can realize flexible power scheduling and reduce the loss of converter. AC and DC distribution network has become an effective way to solve this problem. At the same time, domestic Zhangbei, Guizhou, Guangdong, Jiangsu and other places also began to take the lead in the development of flexible AC and DC distribution system demonstration projects and put them into operation, and the demand for medium voltage AC and DC distribution system also showed an increasing trend. From the perspective of research object and line protection, this study focuses on the technical scheme of line protection for multi voltage AC/DC distribution system. The scheme has low computational complexity, can effectively identify internal and external faults, and reliably protect the whole line. Through the establishment of the system model, the simulation experiments of the system under different fault conditions prove that the protection strategy meets the technical requirements, and meets the actual requirements of the project.

articleTitle: The Impact of PV converter on the grid strength of receiving AC system in MIDCS
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the increase of multi-infeed LCC-HVDC systems (MIDCS’s) capacities, the grid strength of receiving AC systems tends to become weak, which results in static voltage issues. Besides, there have been lots of photovoltaic (PV) converter installed at the receiving AC system of MIDCS. However, the impact of PV converter on the stability of MIDCS has been paid little attention. Therefore, this paper proposes a sensitivity-based method to analyze how the PV converter influences the static voltage stability of the MIDCS. Firstly, we construct the structure-preserving model of MIDCS with a PV converter (located at arbitrary network bus) taken into consideration in quasi-static state. Then, the generalized short-circuit ratio (gSCR) is introduced, which can quantify the grid strength (representing the static voltage stability) of the receiving ac system. Moreover, a sensitivity-based method is proposed to analyze the impact of PV converters on the CgSCR. The theoretical analysis shows that the impact of PV converter on the CgSCR is mainly related with PV converter’s location and control parameter. Finally, we have simulated the effects of different controls parameters and locations of PV converter on the static voltage stability of the receiving AC system in MIDCS and verified the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on inertia and damping mechanism of photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The Photovoltaic with characteristics of low inertia and weak damping is connected to the grid on a large scale, which brings about adverse effects on the grid stability. In this paper, the inertia and damping mechanism of photovoltaic system under typical control strategy is studied, based on the modelling idea of multi-time scale and electric torque method, the source and mechanism of inertia and damping of the system are clarified from the physical mechanism level. The results show that the inertia and damping effect of photovoltaic system can be derived from many links including energy storage elements. Meanwhile, the structural, steady-state operating point and control parameters can influence the inertia, damping and synchronous equivalent parameters of the system. Adjusting control parameters is the easiest way to change the inertia and damping characteristics of the system. The correctness of the above theory and influence law are verified by the MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A fast method for calculating power flow of metro traction power supply
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: To speed up the metro power flow calculation, this paper presents some improvements to the power flow algorithm. The nodes are classified into the s (substation) nodes and the t (train) nodes which are both used to realize the node conductance matrix partition. Because the mutual conductance keeps constant when the train is running in the same section of the two adjacent subations, the mutual conductance is firstly fixed, and then the node self-conductance matrix is dynamically updated according to the variation of the power supply section and the number of trains. The traction substation state in each iteration is only partially changed when solving the power flow by Picard method, so the calculation amount can be reduced by inversing the partitioned matrix. The computational efficiency of the algorithm is verified by using the data of Changsha Metro Line 2.

articleTitle: A planning approach for AC/DC sending-end hybrid power grid with high-pentration renewable energy
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The sending-end power grid stability characteristics will be significantly affected after ultra-high voltage (UHV) DC projects operation and the large-scale renewable energy centralized connection. Based on the analysis of the interaction between the renewable energy, UHV DC project and the weak sending-end power grid, a practical planning approach for AC/DC hybrid power grid was proposed in this paper. The proposed approach, including the renewable energy power characteristics, UHV DC transmission scheme, UHV DC location selection, AC grid construction plan, typical operating mode, security and stability evaluation, clarified key issues in the power grid planning after UHV DC substation connected, which guaranteed the stable and reliable operation of the new energy unit, the UHV DC project and the sending-end power grid. This approach was applied to a real power grid, which was a new energy high-penetration sending-end power grid with a UHV DC project planned. The research results show that the approach proposed in this paper is very practical, because of that the analysis results can guide the construction of the second and the third defence systems related to DC project, and ensure the stability of the system frequency after serious fault of DC system.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Operation Characteristics of AC Energy Consuming Device in VSC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: VSC-HVDC has received extensive attention because of its advantages in power grid expansion, AC systems interconnection and large-scale wind farm integration. However, faults such as the lockout of converter valve will lead to power surplus and voltage instability, which will cause great security threats. Therefore, how to eliminate surplus power and stabilize voltage is a research focus in this field. In this paper, the electrical parameters of Zhangbei Substation are adjusted in a reasonable proportion, a practical model of wind farms and connected power grid are constructed. The model cleverly reflects the operating status and technical characteristics of Zhangbei Substation. Based on that, the effect of energy absorbing device switching operation (timing coordinate with wind turbines and switches) on the islanding system when the converter valve is locked is researched by using electromagnetic transient simulation, which demonstrates its significant effect on absorbing the surplus power and maintaining the stability of voltage. Possible failures of the energy absorbing device itself during the switching process have also been studied. Furthermore, the trend of system power and voltage varies with the fault security is researched. The conclusion provides theoretical support for the fault analysis and troubleshooting strategies of the energy absorbing device in VSC-HVDC project.

articleTitle: Research on configuration of current limiting reactor in multi-terminal HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fault transient of multi-terminal HVDC power grid develops very fast, so it is necessary to configure current limiting reactor to restrain the rise of fault current in practical engineering. However, the configurations of current-limiting reactor will not only limit the fault current, but also affect the non-fault part. Therefore, the configurations of current-limiting reactor in multi-terminal HVDC transmission system are studied in this paper. Firstly, this paper establishes the fault calculation model of multi-terminal HVDC transmission system, and gives the calculation method of system state variables including the active stage of circuit breakers. Then, this paper analyses the problems that need to be considered in the configuration of current-limiting reactor of multi-terminal HVDC transmission system. Finally, this paper takes four-terminal HVDC transmission system as an example, aiming at different configurations of the current-limiting reactor. The faulty process of the current system is simulated and the influence of the current-limiting reactor on the maximum fault current, the blocking of the converter station, the overvoltage of the DC bus and the decay time of the overcurrent is analyzed.

articleTitle: Investigation on surface electric field distribution of workers on/around 110kV cable terminal during live working
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The structure of 110kV high-voltage cable terminal is compact and the distribution of electric field is complex. The magnitude and distribution characteristics of electric field on body surface of live line workers are an important basis for formulating the safety protection and operation methods. In aim to attain the distribution of electric field on body surface of live-line workers under different working conditions, Combined with typical 110kV cable outdoor terminal, established human body’s surface electric field analysis model under three working conditions, namely earth potential, flaoting potential and equal potential, and horizontal and vertical entry path. Analysis results show that: The distortion field intensity of head, hands and feet is relatively large. With the distance between workers and cable terminal increasing by 0.1m, voltage decreases by 8% and electric field drops exponentially. When workers accesses to equal-potential in vertical direction, electric field rises about 2.2kV/m for each upward movement of 0.1m. When human body is in different phases, electric field in phase A to phase C gradually increases by 11% per phase. The operation mode and access path provide a reference for cable terminal live working, which has theoretical value and practical significance for ensuring safety of live line maintenance.

articleTitle: Resilience operation strategy for AC/DC distribution network by coordinating distributed energy storage and VSC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: When an extreme fault occurs in AC/DC distribution network, the optimized control strategy of controllable distributed energy resources in outage area and corresponding voltage source converter (VSC) have a significant impact on the continuous and stable power supply of critical load, the degree of resilience has also improved accordingly. This paper proposed a resilience operation strategy model for AC/DC hybrid distribution network that takes into account coordination of distributed energy storage and VSC. Firstly, the resilience evaluation index systems of AC/DC distribution network based on load ranking is established. Then, the multi-objective resilience operation model of AC/DC distribution network is established with object of minimum load interruption time and minimum power loss. The proposed model is solved by the improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II) embedded in greedy search mechanism to obtain optimal control strategy of distributed energy storage and VSC. Finally, the results of case study show that the proposed method can effectively enhance the resilience of the distribution network and improve the degree of utilization for distributed energy resources by formulating an optimal control strategy of distributed energy resources and VSC, and the resilience of the distribution network will be improved with increase of distributed energy storage capacity.

articleTitle: Harmonic resonance modal analysis of Multi-inverter Grid-connected system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In view of the current situation that large-scale inverters are connected in parallel to the weak grid at the point of common coupling (PCC) through LCL filters, determining the resonance frequency of a multi-inverter grid-connected system based on a frequency domain analysis method requires the establishment of a complex high-order transfer function, but the method cannot provide information on resonance distribution and the degree of participation of each component. In this paper, the resonance modal analysis (RMS) method is used to derive the output impedance model of a single inverter under the Norton equivalent form based on the grid-connected structure and control block diagram of the LCL three-phase inverter. The system's equivalent admittance matrix performs eigenvalue decomposition, obtains the system resonance frequency and the participation factors of each node, and evaluates the resonance characteristics of the system under different numbers of grid-connected inverters and different types of grid-connected inverter combinations. By analyzing the transfer function of the grid-connected current of the inverter and deeply studying the impedance coupling relationship between the inverter and the power grid, the correctness of the modal analysis method and the characteristic of resonance in multi-inverter grid-connected system is verified.

articleTitle: Exploration the operation method of isolated island micro-grid in the new electric changing
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: A new round of electric power system reform for the main body to participate in the market transaction, the chance. Micro power grid as the aggregation of distributed power supply (distributed generation, DG), the effective ways to achieve the DG capacity volatility, stochastic and uncontrolled change, especially under the background of new electric change to microgrid provides a good policy support to participate in market transactions. New electricity to the basic background, this paper studies the operation of the microgrid features and related business, and focuses on analyzing the new electricity island under the change of the microgrid operation characteristic, considering the wind turbines, solar units, fuel cell and energy storage devices and power load of the microgrid model, for the best strategy to achieve internal micro power grid operation structure, the lowest marginal cost, the optimal model in ensuring that the internal network, on the basis of balance between supply and demand, realize the optimal control strategy for micro power grid.

articleTitle: Design and trial production of a 500 kV GIS and Gil bus internal fault simulation platform
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of internal fault diagnosis of 500 kV GIS and Gil equipment, a set of simulation platform for internal fault of 500 kV GIS and Gil bus is designed based on the idea of single-phase structure (single-phase one shell) and basin insulator dividing air chamber, and the field strength of its components is simulated and verified based on the finite element simulation platform. The platform has the functions of effectively simulating overheat fault, discharge fault and internal post insulator defect. It has the expansibility and can explore and apply the cutting-edge technology in this platform. According to the test items of gas insulated metal enclosed switchgear above GB 7674-72.5kv and rigid gas insulated transmission line with rated voltage of 72.5kV and above in GB / T 22383, the factory test was carried out on the prototype and the effectiveness of the platform was verified.

articleTitle: A practical per-unit method of AC/DC system and dynamic regulation process of UHVDC system under engineering control strategy
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: An accurate establishment and solution of UHVDC power flow model is the basis of analyzing the operation state of AC/DC system and realizing the safe and stable operation of power grid, and the per-unit analysis is a common method of power flow calculation. In view of the shortcomings of the per-unit method for AC/DC system in the existing reference, this paper proposes a practical per-unit method to adapt to the different operation conditions of AC system and different equipment parameters of DC system at the sending and receiving ends in an actual UHVDC project. Finally, a practical UHVDC engineering control strategy is introduced, and the dynamic regulation process of DC system is analyzed when the DC transmission power plan changes.

articleTitle: Analysis of reactive power support of back-to-back VSC-HVDC to AC system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: VSC-HVDC technology has the advantages of fast decoupling and independent control of active power and reactive power, and it has certain reactive power support to AC system. Firstly, by analyzing the basic control strategies of VSC-HVDC system, the paper finds the characteristics and mechanism of dynamic reactive power support when using different control strategies. Then, this paper also analyzes how the dynamic reactive power is supported to AC system when the near-zone fault and the far-zone fault occur, with different active power being transmitted by the VSC-HVDC line. Finally, this paper proposes different reactive power control strategies when VSC-HVDC system runs in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Experimental study on V-A characteristics of AC and DC metal oxide varistors under different temperatures
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, the different test platforms are set up to study the V-A characteristics of AC and DC MOV under different temperatures. The entire volt-ampere characteristic includes small current area, operating area(30/60us), lightning area (8/20us), steep wave area(1/5us) and large current area(4/10us). Representative AC and DC MOV in China are chosen as the samples. The experimental results show that AC and DC MOV in small current region exhibit a negative temperature coefficient, that is, at the same current, the higher the temperature, the lower the voltage of MOV. The smaller the current of MOV, the larger the absolute value of the negative temperature coefficient. When the current of MOV is 1mA, the temperature coefficient of DC MOV between -10°C and 120°C is -0.0051 kV/°C, and the temperature coefficient of AC MOV is -0.0063kV/°C. The V-A characteristics of AC and DC MOV in the operating area, lightning area, steep wave area and large current area have little to do with temperature. In the experiment, when the MOV is damaged due to side flash, the voltage and current waveforms will be distorted. The skin effect under high frequency impact can explain the side flash.

articleTitle: Research on short circuit current recognition and zero prediction algorithm for fast switching variable resistance transformer
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to realize fast identification of short-circuit fault current and accurate prediction of zero-crossing point of variable impedance transformer, the short-circuit current identification method based on curvature algorithm of current waveform and the zero-crossing prediction algorithm of short-circuit current based on least square method are studied. The influence of initial phase angle and fundamental frequency angle of different faults on zero prediction under ideal condition, different signal-to-noise ratio and different harmonic conditions is analyzed,and a short-circuit fault model is built with MATLAB and simulated. The results show that the short-circuit current identification method based on curvature algorithm of current waveform and the zero-crossing point prediction algorithm based on least square method can identify fault current quickly, and greatly reduce the prediction error of zero-crossing point time of short-circuit current.

articleTitle: Study on influencing factors of transient current sharing of press pack IGBT
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The press-pack IGBT(PPI) device offer excellent performance in high voltage and high current applications. The reliability of PPI devices is the most important evaluation indicator for device use. The parallel current sharing problem of the PPI device affects the reliability of transient operation. The severe uneven flow can cause chip damage. In this paper, the dual-pulse circuit model of PPI device is established by using professional circuit simulation software, Then according the non-uniform flow indicators, the effects of chip characteristic parameters on the transient current sharing is described. Finally, A feasible method is provided for the chip parameters screening from the perspective of current sharing based on the simulation results.

articleTitle: The calculation method of critical permeability of new energy constrained by static voltage stability
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With large-scale wind power, photovoltaic and other new energy connected to the power grid, the new energy generating unit has begun to affect the stability of the power system. At the same time, constrained by the grid characteristics of new energy connected to the power grid and the safety limitations of new energy equipment, the voltage problem of new energy connected to the grid becomes more prominent. At present, the research on the permeability of the high proportion of new energy connected to the power grid is still in its early stage. This paper mainly studies the critical permeability of new energy constrained by static voltage stability. Firstly, the mathematical model of new energy generating units connected to the power grid is analyzed, and the practical engineering calculation method of critical permeability of new energy based on static voltage stability of 8% constraint is proposed. Then taking the actual power grid as an example, the critical permeability of new energy in the study zone is calculated according to the method proposed in this paper. Finally, several factors affecting the new energy permeability are analyzed through calculation. This study can provide an important basis for the maximum consumption of new energy power generation and regional new energy planning.

articleTitle: Optimal adjustment of power network structure by considering static voltage stability and Short-Circuit current level of multi-infeed DC systems
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: A large-scale multi-infeed direct current (MIDC) system leads to the relatively weak voltage support capability in the receiving AC system. Although it is critical to enhance the strength of AC system for mitigating severe voltage stability issues, it may exacerbate the short-circuit current (SCC) level at the same time. Since the network structure of the MIDC plays a significant role in dealing with the dilemma between grid strength and SCC level, this paper proposes a power network structure optimization method with constraints of static voltage stability and SCC level. First, the generalized short circuit ratio (gSCR) is applied to assess the grid strength of receiving AC system of the MIDC in terms of static voltage stability. Second, the relations between the gSCR and the SCC level are explored. Finally, we propose a solution algorithm based on the sensitivity analysis of SCC, with the goal of minimizing the number of lines to be opened by satisfying the constraints of the gSCR and the SCC level. The proposed method is verified to be effective by simulations that it can both limit the SCC level and ensure the static voltage stability of receiving AC system of the MIDC.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of optical CT breakage at HVDC converter station
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: April 2016, One AC filter of a HVDC converter station occurred optical CT breakage alarm signal. The optical CT composite insulator is inspected, cracks at the first and second umbrella skirt on the high voltage end is found. Also, the optical cable that transmits optical signals is damaged. Finite Element Method (FEM) simulation software was used to calculate the surface electric field of insulators by simulation, the possibility of aging and destruction of organic insulating materials caused by high filed strength creeping discharge is eliminated. Then, the cause of the damage from production process and other aspects is analysis. Some feasible suggestion is proposed based on the research results.

articleTitle: Pollution characteristics of UHVAC new composite cross-arm insulators
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Composite cross-arms are used for constructing transmission tower structures due to their light weight, high strength, corrosion resistance, easy processing, good insulation performance and other advantages. In order to obtain insulation characteristics of UHVAC composite cross-arm insulators, the artificial pollution tests of UHVAC composite cross-arm insulator for single circuit and double circuit transmission lines were carried out.In this paper, the pollution withstand voltage characteristics of UHVAC composite cross-arm insulator with different pollution degree and the pollution withstand voltage characteristics of silicone rubber surface with hydrophilicity and weak hydrophobicity were studied, and compared with the pollution flashover voltage of suspension composite insulator with the same voltage level.The results show that the pollution flashover voltage and pollution degree of UHV composite cross-arm insulator have negative power exponent relationship when the surface of silicon rubber was hydrophilic; the pollution flashover voltageof composite cross-arm insulator under the condition of weak hydrophobicity is more than 15% higher than that under hydrophilic condition.The preliminary design structure satisfies the operating requirement according to the result of the pollution withstand voltage test for the UHV composite cross-arm insulator under the weak hydrophobic nature.

articleTitle: Study on the economy of zero emission transformation of small coal-fired power plant based on SOFC and EV battery cascade utilization
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In the face of the green transformation needs of small-scale coal-fired power plants (SCPP), a scheme of zero emission transformation of small-scale coal-fired power plants based on SOFC and EV Battery cascade utilization is proposed. And the cost-benefit analysis model is proposed to evaluate the feasibility of the solution. In this scheme, fuel cell is used to replace coal-fired power plant, and the recycled EV battery packs is used to output smoothly in steps. Under the condition of maintaining the same power supply capacity of the replaced SCPP, the optimal combination of fuel cell and energy storage cell capacity is calculated by the cost-benefit analysis model, which considers environmental pollution, fuel price and related equipment installation and maintenance costs. The practical case analysis results shown the economic advantages of this scheme will take a long time to appear, but it has an great advantage on considered the zero emission and recyclable hydrogen energy utilization as well as the cascade utilization of electric vehicle batteries.

articleTitle: Mechanical DC breaker for DC distribution network test method
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC circuit breaker has been a research hotspot in recent years. However, currently, DC circuit breakers are frequently used in the lab to perform breaking tests in the laboratory using a power frequency synthesis loop. The equivalence of the DC circuit breaker is to be discussed. This article aims to provide a test system design scheme that satisfies the technical requirements, that is, at a voltage level of 10kV, the system can provide a 2kA rated current and a 20kA short circuit current with a 6kA/ms rise rate to simulate an actual short circuit condition, and Based on this, a successful breaking of the mechanical DC breaker can be achieved. The key work of this paper is to simulate the establishment of the simulation model of the test circuit, as well as the selection of circuit parameters and the selection of components. This enables the shunt to meet the 20kA short-circuit current and the 2kA rated current. The model of DC circuit breaker was established by PSCAD. It has certain guiding significance and reference significance for the actual establishment of DC circuit breakers and test platforms in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Bipartite graph masking modulation for modular multilevel matrix converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C) is a special member of the modular multilevel converter (MMC) family. M3C implements matrix topology using MMC technique. Owing to this characteristic, it has many advantages in low frequency power conversion and high-power motor driving occasions. However, M3C also inherits a few unfavorable features from matrix converter, in which, sophisticated modulation is the most undesirable one. For solving this issue, this paper proposes a bipartite graph masking modulation method based on phase voltage vector which considerably reduce the complexity of M3C modulation. Moreover, a time-based simulation is created and the results verify the proposed scheme which has excellent static and dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Neutral grounding mode of MMC-based DC distribution grid
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With a demonstration project of MMC-based DC distribution grid as the background, this paper studies the neutral grounding mode of DC distribution system with MMC converters and symmetrical single pole wiring structure. When a grounding fault occurs in DC grid, the fault current loop is related to the neutral grounding mode of both AC and DC sides of the converter station. Therefore, the over-current and over-voltage imposed on the converter valve during the fault period can be decided by the grounding mode. This paper selects three optional grounding modes which are the combination of AC side connection transformer neutral point ungrounded or grounded through resistance and DC side neutral point ungrounded or grounded through clamping resistance. Fault characteristics of DC single pole grounding fault for these three neutral grounding modes are analysed using the fault current loop method and simulation results. According to the analysis results, fault current and voltage between the poles for different grounding modes are compared. The results show that the scheme of AC side connection transformer neutral point grounded through appropriate resistance and DC side ungrounded can ensure the safety operation of DC grid during the fault and facilitate fault detection, and is economical.

articleTitle: Optimization of structure for overheating fault simulation of high voltage equipment based on multi-field coupling
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The decomposition characteristics of SF6 insulation gas in the overheat fault condition provide reference for the overheat fault diagnosis of SF6 electrical equipment. Based on normal operation of high-voltage equipment, it is necessary to establish an overheating fault simulation test platform to simulate the generation of local hot high temperature to decompose SF6. In this paper, aiming at the fault temperature of high-voltage equipment, the coupling electromagnetic-fluid-thermal fields verified by e xperiments is used to optimize the current and flow-through component structure to obtain the local hot high temperature meeting the requirements. The calculation results show that the optimized structure and current can provide the temperature required for SF6 equipment fault simulation.

articleTitle: Continuous power flow for hybrid AC/DC microgrid considering uncertainty of intermittent DG output
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The uncertainty of intermittent distributed generator (DG), lack of a slack bus and the bidirectional flow of AC/DC subsystems are unfavourable to security and stability of island AC/DC hybrid microgrid, making the traditional power flow methods difficult to apply. To this end, this study proposes a continuous power flow (CPF) method for this microgrid considering intermittent DG. Firstly, the discrete method based on Wasserstein optimal distance metric is proposed to construct joint scenarios of wind and photovoltaic generation output. Further, a unidirectional prediction-correction CPF is proposed according to the different regions of changing load. This method only needs prediction-correction calculation for the subsystem where the load is changed, while another subsystem uses conventional power flow. Moreover, the key points of initial point and the correction calculation are summarized as determined equations, and accelerated LM algorithm with non-monotone linear search (ALMNL) is proposed to reduce calculation complexity and improve the convergence speed. Finally, the simulation results on the test system prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method The algorithm provides a new method and theoretical support for CPF of power system with intermittent DG, and the voltage stability analysis and operation of AC/DC hybrid system and narrow flow solution microgrid system. The proposed method greatly reduces the complexity of CPF while considering the influence of DG output, ensures the calculation accuracy and greatly reduces the calculation time. The uniformity of the solution of the tidal equations has global convergence and faster local convergence speed simultaneously.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of arc on oil flow rate during switching process of large capacity transformer on-load tap-changer
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The on-load tap-changer is an important device in the power grid to adjust the load flow and improve the reactive power distribution, which is directly related to the safe and stable operation of the power system. At present, it is urgent to carry out relevant research on the mechanism of oil flow surge and on-load misoperation caused by arc energy during normal switching of on-load switches of high voltage and large capacity transformers. Based on the calculation method of oil flow rate during the normal switching process of transformer on-load tap-changer, the theoretical limit of oil flow rate is obtained by analyzing and calculating the arc energy. Taking the CMIII 1000 on-load tap-changer as an example, the finite element analysis model of the oil flow rate during the switching process of the on-load tap-changer is established. The theoretical limit value of oil flow rate is obtained, which is verified by comparison with the theoretical calculation results. The above research can provide a certain engineering reference value for improving the reliability of the non-electricity protection action of the oil flow control relay.

articleTitle: Micro-meteorological analysis and prediction for transmission lines in micro-geography environment
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to investigate the icing condition of the transmission line which across the Micro-Geography (MG) and Micro-Meteorological (MM), in this paper, on the basis of micro-climate theory, the regression model between meteorological factors is established by the multiple regression analysis method, taking three transmission lines which with typical micro-topography distribution in North China Grid and occurred accidents in history as an example. The results show that the method can reveal the relationship between micro-meteorological parameters from a quantitative angle and make the meteorological analysis and prediction of transmission lines in micro-geography environment more accurately. It lay a foundation for real-time evaluation of electrical reliability of transmission lines and the establishment of early warning system. This work is supported by Science and Technology Project of State Grid Tianjin Electric Power Company (Research on Prediction Technology of Transmission Lines Wet Snow Flash in Coastal Heavy Pollution Areas, No. KJ19-1-07).

articleTitle: Analysis and design of 24V DC control contactor
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Traditionally, the AC contactor was controlled by exerting continuous DC current to the coil in both magnetic attracting and maintaining process. This would result in the electromagnetic force overloaded, and the wear between the moving contact and static contact intensified. As time went on, the coil heating would become serious, and the lifespan of contactors would be reduced. Therefore, PWM and DC-DC control schemes were used in this paper to achieve the purpose of saving energy and prolong the lifespan of contactors. The design process of PWM and DC-DC control circuits was introduced. By comparing PWM and DC-DC control schemes in performance and cost evaluation, the final plan was determined. Also the system software was completed. The electronic control unit and the whole contactor machine were tested. Compared with contactors by coil direct control, our contactor can save 43.19% energy, and extend the electrical life by 19.30% on average. Compared with similar contactors by electronic control, our contactor can save 17.5% energy, and extend the electrical life by 6.66% on average.

articleTitle: Influence of wind-sand erosion on the electric field of fittings in 750 kV substation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The 750 kV substations in the Northwest China are mostly located in sandstorm-prone areas. Due to long-term erosion by wind and sand, corona discharge is serious with noise pollution in these substations. In this paper, taking a 750 kV substation as an example, corona discharge in the substation was observed by using ultraviolet (UV) imaging technology. The results of UV imaging show that wind-sand erosion will make the surface of fittings uneven and produce different forms of defects, which will lead to serious corona discharge. In order to study the effect of wind-sand erosion on fittings, three-dimensional finite element model of a certain bay of the substation was established by using finite element analysis (FEA) software, and models of the fittings eroded by sandstorm and smooth models without erosion were adopted respectively in the simulation. Then, the electric field distribution of the substation was calculated, and the electric field characteristics of fittings with different defects were analysed. The simulation results show that defect type, size and position will influence the characteristics of electric field distribution with different laws. The study could provide guidance for the structure design of fittings and the reduction of corona discharge in 750 kV substations.

articleTitle: The function design of UHVDC control and protection system based on hierarchical connection technology
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the development of UHV DC transmission technology, the DC voltage level reaches ±1100kV and the transmission power reaches 10GW.Through hierarchical connection technology, it can effectively reduce the impact of DC power grid failure on AC 500kV power grid by hierarchical connecting the receiving-end to the 500kV/1000 kV AC power grid and achieve a more optimal allocation of resources. As the control center of the converter station, the secondary control and protection system realizes the stable transmission of DC power and protect the reliable operation of the DC transmission system. According to the characteristics of hierarchical connection, the hierarchical structure design of control and protection system is carried out, and the hierarchical structure of control and protection system for hierarchical connection is proposed. Study the design of control and protection functions of conventional UHV DC projects, and complete the hierarchical connection to all levels of the system control the protection function configuration; the key researches on control function of hierarchical connection mode such as reactive power control, tap coordination control, and voltage balance control are studied. The corresponding control strategy is proposed and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Characteristics of faults of high voltage overhead transmission lines caused by Typhoon in east coast of China
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Typhoon is one of the most severe natural disasters that can heavily damage the high voltage power transmission network and even cause the blackout of major coastal cities. This work first collected the data of the faults of 110kV and above overhead transmission lines during the last 14 years in Zhejiang and Fujian Provinces. 479 fault records were collected and were stored in a structured dataset. Then the geography characteristics, like the distance between the fault towers to the canter of the typhoon and the distance between the fault towers and the coastline were analysed. The other characteristics, like correlations between fault time and typhoon landing time, were also analysed in this work. This work found that most of the faults were highly concentrated in the close vicinity to the coastline and the gust of typhoon caused most of but not the severest faults. Beside these conclusions, there are multiple other findings in this work that are useful in designing a typhoon disaster warning algorithm.

articleTitle: A multi-dimensional synchronization method for 5G communication-based current differential protection of distribution networks
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fifth generation mobile communication (5G communication) technology with high bandwidth and low latency provides a promising way to configure the full-line high-speed protection such as current differential protection in the distribution network in the aspect of the communication mode. Based on these characteristics of 5G communication, the 5G communication latency test for the distribution network is firstly conducted in the laboratory, and the adaptability of various traditional synchronization methods for the current differential protection is then analysed. Furthermore, this paper proposes a multi-dimensional synchronization method for the current differential protection under 5G communication networks, which deploys the external signal-based synchronization method as the main method and the reference voltage and fault signal-based synchronization methods as the auxiliary methods.

articleTitle: Design and test verification of ± 10.5 kV LCC-VSC hybrid three-terminal test system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the development of VSC-HVDC, inherent limitations of traditional half-bridge MMC-HVDC prevents the requirements for high reliability from satisfaction in several application scenarios such as overhead lines, which restricts the expansion of VSC-HVDC industry. In order to solve the problems caused by the half-bridge MMC, the schemes of installing a DC circuit breaker or adopting a hybrid topology (HMMC + FMMC) have been adopted to achieve DC fault isolation or fault ride through. At the same time, related scholars have also proposed a hybrid DC transmission mode of LCC-VSC and carried out related research on the hybrid operating characteristics of LCC-VSC to improve the economy of the system. From the perspective of hybrid DC transmission applications, this paper introduces a system design scheme of a hybrid three-terminal DC transmission system composed of ± 10.5 kV LCC and hybrid topology VSC, which relates to system main equipment selection, equipment parameter design method and system function design requirements, and finally verifies the correctness of the design method and functional design requirements in the built ± 10.5 kV LCC-VSC three-terminal test system.

articleTitle: Research on transient modeling method and applicability of distributed wind farm
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Doubly-fed induction wind turbines are dispersed and integrated into distribution network with high permeability, showing different electromagnetic transient characteristics from traditional power sources, which makes conventional protection of distribution lines difficult to adapt. Based on the transient equivalent model of single doubly-fed induction wind power generation unit, this paper studies the transient clustering equivalence method for DFIG multi-access distributed wind farms based on the dynamic characteristics of rotor fault current. The characteristics of rotor fault current of DFIG units after faults are analyzed to provide basis for the selection and judgment of low voltage traversing control mode. A known terminal voltage and wind speed of DFIG units after faults are studied. The short circuit current of DFIG rotor is calculated to judge the control mode after faults. The units with the same low voltage traversing mode are clustered by clustering algorithm. The output current of clustered wind farm is compared with detailed transient modeling and wind speed equivalent wind farm modeling. At the same time, the effectiveness of transient modeling of decentralized wind farm is validated by combining the field recorded data of a decentralized wind farm.

articleTitle: Research on real-time simulation time error correction method based on virtual power
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The real-time simulation of power system can realize the real-time data interaction with the external physical equipment. However, with the increasing scale of distribution network, the realtime simulation of complex distribution network may need to be implemented by multiple computers after being divided into blocks, which may cause errors and instability problems due to time synchronization. This paper proposes a time synchronization method based on virtual power, which assumes that there is an imaginary virtual circuit composed of resistance and inductance at the common coupling point between different simulation modules. The voltage difference between the two coupling points is used as the input to calculate the consumed power. When the voltage signals at both ends are synchronized, the virtual power is zero, and synchronization is achieved. If the virtual power is not equal to zero, the virtual power is sent to the PI regulator as the error signal, and the output is used to correct the time of the simulator until the virtual power is zero. In this paper, the theoretical analysis and implementation method of this time synchronization scheme are given in detail, and simulation verification is performed. The simulation results show the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Design and accomplishment of immersive virtual reality in safety training of offshore oil platform power system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Any improper work operation may lead to electrical safety accidents such as equipment failure and life safety. Design and accomplishment of immersive virtual reality (IVR) in safety training of oil platform power system was put forward in this paper. The purpose of power system safety training based on IVR technology is essentially to improve the interface ability between employees and relevant information of power system. On the basis of having a set of hardware equipment based on IVR technology, users can immerse themselves in the virtual world through this set of IVR equipment, and interact with the software platform through matching input and output devices to achieve the purpose of safety training. After full investigation, from micro to macro, from model to scene, a virtual power station scene and its safety training story line are constructed by using 3ds MAX software and Unity 3D software. On this basis, the operation function of the student module, the interaction function of the teacher module, and the registration and assessment management function of the system are developed. The installation of power system safety training based on virtual reality technology was used in a power station, which can significantly enhance the safety awareness and operation level of power employees.

articleTitle: The performance analysis of three types of compensation topologies for high-frequency wireless power transfer system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Electromagnetic coupled resonant wireless power transfer (WPT) technology can realize the soft connection of energy and has received extensive attention in recent years. To reduce the volume of the device and further improve the operating frequency and efficiency of the system, this paper proposed to build a high-frequency WPT using silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET. Based on the two-port network and the T-model equivalent circuit, the mathematical model of the resonant circuit is obtained. The transmission characteristics of series–series (SS), double-sided LCL and double-sided LCC resonant circuits are analyzed at high-frequency. The studies show that under the same circuit parameters, the double-sided LCC resonant circuit has a stronger carrying capacity while maintaining high transmission efficiency, which solves the problem of the small transmission power of double-sided LCL. Finally, a double-sided LCC type WPT experimental prototype with an operating frequency of 600kHz, an input voltage of 48V, an input power of 600W and transmission efficiency of ≥ 90% was built. Which provides a reference for the design of high-frequency WPT and the analysis of resonant circuits.

articleTitle: Investigation on the insulating properties of FRP composites cross arms for 10kv distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fiber reinforced polymers (FRP) are increasingly used in cross arms with good insulating and mechanical properties. In this paper, the insulating properties of the rectangular tube polyurethane composite cross arms were investigated. Lightning impulse test, wet power frequency flashover and withstand test, power frequency pollution flashover and withstand test are carried out for the composite cross arm. Furthermore, the electrical properties of polyurethane composites were tested, including volume resistivity, surface resistivity, dielectric loss factor and surface hydrophobicity. The results show that under the same conditions, the insulating properties of FRP composite cross arm are much better than that of iron cross arm. The polyurethane composite has high surface resistivity and volume resistivity, and the surface of the material has certain hydrophobicity, which can improve the surface insulating performance of the cross arm. The FRP composite cross arms are especially suitable for the areas with frequent lightning activities, humidity, and heavy pollution. The evaluation results above will be of great significance to the operational reliability of FRP composite cross arms.

articleTitle: Novel general-purpose IGBT test platform for hybrid DC circuit breakers and analysis
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) devices for hybrid Direct Current (DC) circuit breakers must not only ensure their safety and reliability, but also fully exploit their capabilities, especially the turn-off capability. However, the current research on IGBT device characteristic in this application is not perfect, especially the turn-off characteristics with high current. Therefore, it is necessary to test the ultimate capability of IGBT devices through special test platforms, including ultimate turn-off capability, reclosing turn-off capability and so on. This paper proposes an electrical stress test circuit for IGBT devices from the perspective of hybrid DC circuit breakers. Firstly, the electrical stress commonality of IGBT devices under different circuit breaker topologies and operating conditions is analyzed and summarized. Based on this, a new universal test circuit topology of IGBT devices for hybrid DC circuit breakers is proposed. The proposed test circuit has good flexibility in circuit parameter adjustment to meet different tests and analysis requirements of DC circuit breaker under various operating conditions. And then the corresponding test platform is built based on the circuit. Further, a simplified model considering the parasitic parameters and special component parameters is established for the test platform, and then the analytical analysis of the electrical stress of the tested IGBT device is obtained at each phase of the test. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the test circuit and the highly adjustment of the test electrical stress. The test circuit topology, test electrical stress analysis and adjustment methods proposed in this paper can be widely applied to the evaluation and R&D test of IGBT devices for circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Acquiring the sample data of single-phase ARC grounding fault in power line for application of deep learning
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Arc grounding faults occur frequently in power lines due to hill fire, lightning strike and insulator flashover. It is difficult to directly detect the occurrence of it since arc has strong nonlinear characteristic. AI technologies, such as deep learning is a good way to use, but it need large quantities sample data. In response to this problem, based on the previously proposed logarithmic arc ground model, an improved data correction algorithm is proposed to solve the V-I phase angle difference between the profile produced by logarithmic arc ground model and the real recorded one. The corrected data waveform has more similar external characteristics to the real waveform V-I curve, which can be used to provide data support for the follow-up deep learning algorithm in arc grounding fault detection.

articleTitle: Simulation calculation and analysis of insulation thermal breakdown of XLPE cable under DC voltage
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The high voltage direct current (HVDC) cable and its accessory is one of the necessary equipment for connecting the power supply and the user. As the transmission capacity increases and the voltage level rises, it become particularly difficult to design and test the DC cable insulation system. In particular, the heat and the electric field are complicated under DC, and the conventional method cannot be used for the insulation breakdown under DC. This paper proposes a method that can effectively judge the insulation breakdown through simulation calculation. Based on the classical principle of insulation thermal breakdown, this paper calculates the judgment conditions for the simplified flat panel model under two extreme by study the XLPE materials. In the simulation, we calculated the transient breakdown process of XLPE in complex environment by using the judgment conditions, and analyzed the effects of ambient temperature, pressurization rate and insulation thickness on the insulation breakdown process. We proposed the relationship between the simulation results and the Weibull distribution scale parameters of the experimental data by comparing the simulation results and the experimental data. This method can be used to provide a basis for the withstand voltage design of the DC cable system.

articleTitle: Coordinated control strategy for improving DC voltage quality of VSC-MTDC systems
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC voltage is the most vital parameter of a voltage source converter based multiterminal high voltage direct current (VSC-MTDC) system. The traditional voltage droop control strategy allows a number of converters to simultaneously participate in the DC voltage regulation and active power sharing. However, following a disturbance, the DC voltage may hit their limits. In order to improve the quality of the DC voltage, a coordinated control strategy based on the droop control strategy is proposed. The coordinated control strategy adds supplementary terms to the outer controllers of all droop stations according to the difference between the weighted DC voltage and pre-defined value of weighed DC voltage. Using the proposed control strategy, the steady active power injections keeps almost unchanged and the quality of DC voltage can be improved compared to that under the traditional droop control strategy. Simulations are conducted on a four-terminal VSC-HVDC system using PSCAD/EMTDC software to validate the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on phase shift control of dual-active-bridge converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The problem of the phase shift angle adjustment range of Dual Active Bridge(DAB) converter is studied in this paper. The current stress problem in the different phase shift angle adjustment range of the key components in the DAB converter is thoroughly studied to determine the corresponding phase shift angle adjustment range, reduce the current stress of key components, and improve the converter operating efficiency. The concept of “reactive power” is introduced in the research process. The problem of reactive circulating produced by DAB converter is analyzed quantitatively. The variation rule of reactive power of DAB converter is determined. By adjusting switching frequency, the reactive circulating can be reduced effectively and the working efficiency of converter can be improved. Finally, the DAB converter experimental platform is built and relevant experiments are carried out, the results of which verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Operation analysis of cap and pin suspension ceramic insulators with composite shed for DC transmission lines in China
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Composite porcelain insulators are a new type of insulator. At present, the number of various types of composite porcelain insulators in operation at various voltage levels in China Power Grid has reached 3 million pieces, and its operating status has not been studied at present. This article summarizes the problems found in the anti-pollution treatment of UHV lines, and introduces the application history and current status of composite porcelain insulators. Sampling and testing of 42 pieces of 3 different types of DC composite porcelain insulators running for 4 years, it was found that with the exception of 21.4% of the test samples, the hydrophobicity was reduced to HC4 (including HC3-HC4), and other sampling indicators met the requirements of the standard. It was suggested that the storage, handling, installation and operation maintenance management of composite porcelain insulators should be strengthened.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on lightning overvoltage of 500kV substation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: 500kV Nanning substation is the pivot of the power transmission from west to East.In the past 10 years, Nanning substation has been expanded and operation mode has changed. It will have a negative impact on the operation of the local power grid when lightning damage accident happened in Nanning substation. The study built a substation model and calculated the amplitude of transient overvoltage in equipment due to shielding failure and back flash on 500kV transmission lines. According to the simulation results, the lightning surge insulation margin of the equipment in the substation was checked. Meanwhile, the influence of different factors on amplitude of lightning overvoltage were studied. The simulation results provide references for the safe operation of power grid and the improvements to design for lightning protection.

articleTitle: A novel approach to last circuit breakers identification in hybrid AC/DC power grids
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The last circuit breaker (LCB) protection is applied to the hybrid AC/DC power grids for avoiding severe overvoltage problems in the AC/DC equipment caused by the direct tripping of the LCBs, which are the critical circuit breakers in the AC field to keep the connection between DC systems and AC systems. In order to correct and fast identification of the LCBs, a self-adaptive LCBs identification method in the hybrid AC/DC power grids based on the BFS algorithm is proposed. The network topology of the AC field is firstly represented as an undirected connected graph. Then, the adjacency matrix for the undirected connected graph is established according to the real-time status of circuit breakers. Finally, the LCBs identification problem is formulated as a solving the path’s cut vertices problem by utilizing the breadth-first search (BFS) algorithm. The simulation results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed scheme for the LCBs identification under various operation modes of the AC field.

articleTitle: Optimal coordinated control of steady-state voltage stability in AC/DC systems incorporating VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the increasing use of VSC-HVDC links, voltage stability control has become a vital issue in AC/DC power systems. This paper proposes an optimal coordinated control (OCC) method in AC/DC systems incorporating VSC-HVDC to exploit the ability of VSC-HVDC to enhance steady-state voltage stability. First, this paper extends L-index to AC/DC systems incorporating VSC-HVDC. Then based on this, two kinds of optimal coordinated control are proposed respectively for voltage deviation correction and voltage stability enhancement. The optimal coordinated control is modelled as a linearly constrained quadratic programming problem based on sensitivity, which can get a solution quickly. The model considers characteristics of different controllable variables so it can coordinate the controllable resources of a power system. Furthermore, based on the proposed optimal coordinated control, a control strategy is designed which can jointly ensure voltage stability margin and maintain voltage magnitude in a reasonable range. In this way, the ability of VSC-HVDC systems participating in voltage stability control is fully exploited. The result of the simulation on modified New England 39-bus power system shows that the proposed method can comprehensively coordinate control variables and effectively enhance voltage stability.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the green function of a point current source in a horizontal multilayered soil with the deformed paths on complex plane and its application in grounding system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fast evaluation of the matrix R that stands for the mutual grounding coupling is essential for modelling a grounding system if the moment method is utilized. To accelerate the calculation of the entry of the matrix R, a cubic Hermite interpolation model is proposed, which exploits a feature that the buried depth of a grounding system keeps unchanged. To generate the interpolation function efficiently, the key is the fast evaluation of the Green function of a point current source in a horizontal multi-layered soil. In this paper, with the help of highly accurate approximation of Bessel function, the Green function is calculated along several deformed integral paths on complex plane, instead of the conventional real axis. On the complex plane, the kernel of Green function no long presents highly oscillatory, but exponentially decayed. The immediate advantage of this property is the computing time is reduced dramatically. Numerical examples show the proposed approach is competitive in accuracy and computing time.

articleTitle: Study on MOA heat dissipation characteristics and influencing factors under transient impact load
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: By analysing and researching many gapless metal oxide surge arresters (MOA) accidents, it is found that thermal collapse accounts for a high proportion of MOA damage accidents. During operation, if the heat is higher than the heat dissipation during the MOA's impact load, the temperature of the resistor will increase and eventually cause the MOA to collapse. The thermal dissipation characteristics exhibited by MOA are related to transient impact load, MOA structure, component material, operating charge rate and other factors. Therefore, studying MOA heat dissipation and influencing factors is of great significance for the design and safe operation of MOA. Taking the typical 35kV composite housing MOA and porcelain housing MOA as examples, the thermal dissipation characteristics of MOA are studied from the aspects of transient impact load, MOA structure, charge rate and surface contamination. The control variable method is used to conclude that the heat dissipation characteristics of the porcelain housing MOA are better. In addition, the lower the charge rate of the arrester and the lower the surface contamination, the better the heat dissipation characteristics of the MOA. When studying the influence of transient load, the heat absorbed by MOA under square wave is higher than that of lightning current and large current, and the heat dissipation characteristic is the worst.

articleTitle: Overview of research on modelling and parameter identification of wind power generator
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The calculation accuracy of the new energy power system is affected by the veracity of new energy model, of which control parameters in the wind turbine controller from different manufacturers are not easily obtained. Modelling and parameter identification of wind turbine are investigated in this paper. Firstly, the acquisition approach on the original data for parameter identification is investigated. Secondly, parameter identification methods including classical identification methods and modern identification methods are summarized, in which the application scenarios and limitations are analyzed. Finally, some suggestions on the future research direction of wind turbine parameter identification are put forward.

articleTitle: Steady and transient characteristics analysis for parallel cables
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the increasing power consumption, single-core power cables in parallel have been widely used to improve the transmission capacity. However, there is a complex electro-magnetic coupling between parallel cables in same phase, the current distribution may not be even. This phenomenon will not only lead to a decline in transmission capacity of the line, but also may cause the overheating, even breakdown in parts of the cables. In this paper, based on the model to analyse the current unbalanced degree in parallel cables, the influential factors were studied. It was found that the arrangement was the most important influential factor. The Mutual Unbalanced Degree(MUD) was the least when cables were under symmetry-reverse phase sequence. By using the monitoring data of a 220 kV cable line in parallel, the analysis model was proved to be extremely accurate. Also the transient characteristics of parallel cables were analysed by ATP-EMTP electromagnetic transient analysis software. When single-phase grounding fault happened, the short-circuit current at different fault points was calculated. It was found that single-cable grounding happening at the middle section was the most serious. Single-phase grounding happened at terminal was slighter. Single-phase grounding happened at headend was the slightest.

articleTitle: A novel scheme of refurbishing the existing LCC-HVDC to VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Refurbishing the existing LCC-HVDC (Line Commutated Converter based HVDC) to VSC-HVDC (Voltage Source Converter based HVDC) station, is an economical scheme. this paper introduces a novel refurbishment scheme which simply replaces the LCC valves with VSC valves, reserving converter transformers and bushings of LCC-HVDC. Several main connection schemes are compared firstly. Based on the results, designing process of main circuit parameters of the proposed refurbishment scheme is elaborated. The designing results show that the proposed refurbishment scheme can greatly reduce the request for sub-module capacitor and current capacity. Finally, simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the feasibility of proposed refurbishment scheme.

articleTitle: Accurate selection method of neutral grounding resistance in urban distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the development of city scale and for the purpose of city beautification, the capacitance current increases greatly in the distribution network, which will cause the capacity and volume of over compensated arc suppression coil to increase, and also bring inconvenience to the maintenance and operation of the power grid. At present, many urban power grids are transforming the neutral point grounding mode of distribution network, namely, the neutral point is grounded through low resistance. This grounding method can not only limit the over-voltage of the system but also improve the operation characteristics of the relay protection. The fault characteristics of single-phase ground fault and the action characteristics of zero sequence current protection were analyzed in detail when the neutral point is grounded through a low resistance. The selection method of low resistance value of neutral point was proposed to ensure reliable operation of zero sequence current protection. The relationship between the value of low resistance and the capacitance current was analyzed, with respect to the capacity of distribution network and other factors. The validity of proposed grounding resistance selection method is verified by numerous simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC. It shows that the proposed selection method of grounding resistance for distribution network is helpful for fault detection and clearance.

articleTitle: Research on the energy characteristics of the potential transfer current of UHV AC transmission line along the tension-proof string
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of the line and workers during the live operation of the 1000kV UHV AC transmission line, the related characteristics of the potential transfer current energy when the UHV AC transmission line enters and exits along the tension series are studied.
