In this paper, the potential transfer current during the entry and exit of a 1000kV UHV AC transmission line is measured by a potential transfer current acquisition device at the high-voltage side. The time domain characteristics such as pulse width, amplitude and pulse interval are analyzed. The potential transfer current amplitude of UHV tensile strings is high and the energy is large. A potential transfer rod should be used during the operation.

articleTitle: Stray inductance extraction method based on interrupting transient process for power electronic component in hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The power electronic component (PEC) is the key part that determines the breaking capacity of hybrid DC circuit breaker. The internal stray inductances have significant impacts on the interrupting performance of PEC due to the extremely high current rate when the component interrupts the short circuit current. Firstly, this paper analyses the commutation stages of the diode-bridge component during the turn-off process. The commutation loops of the first and the second commutation period are depicted and the equations for stray inductances extraction are given. Then, a test platform is built for 10 kA interrupting experiments of PEC. By analysing the detailed current and voltage waveforms of the two commutation stages, the optimal periods of the stray inductance extraction for the two commutation loops are pointed out and the stray inductances are extracted based on the experimental data. Finally, the 3D protype of PEC is given and the reasons for the difference in the extraction results of the first commutation loop utilizing two transient processes are listed.

articleTitle: Optimization of insulation structure for gis basin insulator with multi-objective algorithm
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: A large number of GIS basin insulators have been used in UHV AC transmission projects, of which the performance is directly related to the safety and reliability of power system. Reasonable insulation structure can improve the electrical properties of GIS basin insulators. In this paper, the multi-objective algorithm has been used to optimize the insulation structure of GIS basin insulator. The evaluation function of multi-objective function is constructed by combining the judgment matrix approach with the linear weighting, and then transformed into single-objective optimization problem. The optimization has achieved good results. The electric field intensity on the typical positions of GIS basin insulator could satisfy the criteria values. The maximum electric field strength on the interface between the center conductor and basin body decreases from 13280 V/mm to 10271V/mm, reduced by 22.65%.

articleTitle: Warning method of fault for lead-acid battery of energy storage system based on its resistance prediction
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fault of the battery affects the reliability of the power supply, thus threatened the safety of the battery energy storage system (BESS). A fault warning method based on the predicted battery resistance and its change rate is proposed. The causes of the resistance change of the battery are classified, and the influencing factors of battery internal resistance are quantified. The prediction model of the battery resistance is constructed by the long-and-short-time memory neural network (LSTM) with the inputs of the state, voltage, current, temperature of the battery. The signal of the fault warning is issued and the cause of the fault is determined with the predicted battery resistance and its change rate. The results of the experiment show that the error of the prediction method of the battery resistance is within 3%. The fault warning method is beneficial to the safe operation of the BESS.

articleTitle: Design of voltage Sag and Harmonic detection algorithm for distribution network dynamic voltage restorer
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The voltage sag and harmonic detection in distribution network with high proportion of DG is a hot issue[1-3]. The dynamic voltage restorer is an effective method. The detection algorithm is the first and key part. In this paper firstly the voltage sag and harmonic detection problems of distribution network with a large number of DGs integration are discussed. S-transform and improved multi DQ coordinate rotation transform are respectively designed. For a further verify, simulations are carried out in Matlab. The results show that the improved multi DQ coordinate rotation transform method is more flexible for dynamic voltage restorer.

articleTitle: Improved frequency scanning of SSR risks in series-compensated UHVAC transmission systems
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: It is a great challenge to evaluate subsynchronous resonance (SSR) for a practical ultra-high-voltage alternative current (UHVAC) transmission system due to the huge number of operating conditions. Conventionally, frequency scanning is applied to the risky generators one by one to identify those operating conditions, under which the generator is vulnerable to SSR risks. However, this method requires massive calculation for analysing the stability of the system with multiple generators. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved frequency scanning method for SSR stability analysis, with which the repeated calculation can be effectively avoided. The equivalent impedance network model of the entire system is established at first, wherein each generator is represented by its sub-transient reactance. Next, the electrical resonance frequency of the system under various operating conditions is obtained. Then, the operating condition of each generator that may cause SSR accidents can be obtained by comparing the generator’s torsional frequency and the electrical resonance frequency. Finally, the electromagnetic transient model (EMT) is established in PSCAD/EMTDC based on the thermal power system in Xilin Gol League of China, and the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are validated by time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Resonance characteristic analysis of flexible DC distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The use of large number of complex and non-linear power electronic equipment in DC distribution networks will inevitably bring a series of harmonic problems to the system. One of which is called harmonic instability, which is caused by resonance in the DC system. In this paper, the basic topology of DC distribution network and the reasons for harmonic instability is analyzed, then, based on the switch function theory, the calculation formula of the DC side harmonic impedance of MMC, which is the core equipment of DC distribution network, is derived. Finally, taking a typical flexible DC power distribution demonstration project as an example, the DC side harmonic impedance of MMC is analyzed and the analysis results are verified by PSCAD simulation. Verification results show that, the calculation model can accurately calculate the harmonic impedance of the DC distribution network, which is of reference value for managing harmonic content and avoiding harmonic instability.

articleTitle: The prediction of wind power interval based on k-means clustering algorithm and hoeffding tree classification algorithm
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: At present, people pay more and more attention to the development of new energy . In this paper, a data preprocessing method by combining k-means clustering algorithm and hoeffding tree classification algorithm is proposed. The original relevant data is processed by clustering through the k-means method, therefore the original data is labeled after clustering. Then hoeffding decision tree classification algorithm is applied. The label data is predicted after using the classification tree to cluster the data. Then the label data is optimized. Then the preprocessed data is used as the input of neural network for learning and training, and the probability density distribution of training error is obtained. Then the upper and lower bounds of interval prediction are drawn with the Z value of normal distribution under 95 confidence degree. Finally, the probability interval prediction of future wind power generation is realized.

articleTitle: Degradation mechanism of electric joint compound which uesd in DC terminal connectors
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC Terminal Connectors frequently face with abnormal fever problems due to the increase of contact resistance. The degradation of electric joint compounds is mainly responsible for the increasement. However, the degradation mechanism of electric joint compound is unclear. In this paper, artificial accelerated aging tests were put on the electric joint compounds to simulating their aging mode. The conductivity of DC terminal connectors was measured during the thermo-oxidative aging progress. Micro structural analysis tests including FTIR, XPS, XRD were used to proclaim the changes of the electric joint compounds. It is concluded that the increase of crosslinking extent and the volatilization of small molecule siloxanes, have great impact on the operation performance of the electric joint compounds.

articleTitle: Planning of active power distribution network based on source-network-load collaborative optimization
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the fast development of renewable energy generation, the randomness and volatility seriously threaten the stability of the power system. In order to improve the consumption rate of renewable energy and the economic benefit, the source-network-load collaborative optimization is put forward and widely used in the power system. And the active power distribution network which consists of the energy storage devices and flexible load is the best carrier to realize it. Based on the active power distribution network planning, this paper firstly designs an economic index covering construction cost and operation cost as the optimization objective. Then with the physical constraints consisting of the physical features of generation units, energy storage devices and flexible load, the source-network-load collaborative optimization model of active power distribution network is established. Finally, a case of city distribution network is presented to verify the effect of source-network-load collaborative optimization and the efficiency of the optimization model.

articleTitle: Controller parameter optimization of direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator based on SGA-SVM classification
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, a simulation model of direct-drive wind power generation system (WPGS) is established. The training samples of subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) are generated by changing parameters of the grid-side controller during time domain simulation. These samples are classified to be stable and unstable using nonlinear support vector machine (SVM) classification. The simple genetic algorithm (SGA) is used to optimize the hyperparameters of SVM, which improves the accuracy of prediction. Simulation analysis shows that the proposed model provides the possibility to predict the stability of system accurately with the parameter settings of grid-side controller. When the system is predicted as unstable, the grid-side controller parameters can be changed to recommended values to ensure the safety and stability of power system operation.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Natural Contamination Characteristics of Insulators of ±800kV UHVDC Line and 1000kV UHVAC Line
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: For the study of UHVAC and DC lines relationship on contamination, this paper focuses on the parallel part of ±800kV Tianshan-Zhongzhou Line and 1000kV Changzhi-Nanyang line. Natural contamination experiments and analysis are conducted. Experiment results indicate that when the natural pollution accumulation processes for a long time, UHVDC line insulator is more seriously polluted than that of the parallel UHVAC line. By comparing the pollution degree of insulator strings of different heights, the ESDD and NSDD of line insulators in this area decrease when the suspension height increases, and the ESDD and NSDD of insulators at 50m height are 40% and 55% lower than those at 10m respectively. The comparison and analysis of contamination components shows that the main cations and anions of the surface pollution of UHVDC and UHVAC line insulators in this area are almost same. In addition, under UHVAC and UHVDC voltage, there is little difference of the insoluble components and their proportion of insulator surface pollution. Through the enrichment factors of main components in the soluble substance of the pollutants, it can be seen that the pollution sources around the transmission lines have basically the same influence on the UHVAC and UHVDC transmission lines.

articleTitle: Study on fuse protected arrester for MRTB in ±660kV converter station
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In recent years, there have been many failures of metallic return transfer breaker due to the damage of arrester in parallel. In the process of switching operation in converter station, the mutil-colum arrester needs to absorb huge energy in a short time during switching. However, the energy absorption by zinc oxide varistors is unbalanced. Considering the influence of long-term operation and environmental factors, the reduction of volt-ampere characteristics of some varistors absorb more energy than others. When the absorbed energy exceeds its thermal capacity, the breakdown fault will occur. In order to solve the problem of arrester failure, the concept of fuse protected arrester is adopted in this paper, parameter requirements of MRTB arrester through theoretical calculation and simulation study are put forward, and the new structure of multi-column arrester in this station is proposed.

articleTitle: Resilience assessment of distribution network considering operation duration and operational risk
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In recent years, power system failure events caused by high-risk and low-probability extreme events have occurred frequently in the world, and resilience is used to describe the system's ability to adapt and recover from extreme events. In order to accurately evaluate the resilience of the distribution network, resilience metrics and evaluation method considering the system operation duration and risk are proposed and verified. Firstly, the resilience metrics of the distribution network considering the operation duration and risk are proposed. Then, the probability distribution of different distributed renewable energy sources and loads is fitted by kernel density estimation (KDE) method. To reflect the uncertainty of distributed renewable energy and load, the scenes are generated by latin hypercube sampling (LHS) and cholesky method, and simultaneous backward reduction (SBR) method is used to reduce the generated scenes. Secondly, a two-layer optimization model of system operation duration and operational risk, which takes into account the uncertainty of renewable energy generation is proposed. According to the internal and external evaluation results, the resilience of the system under a given risk constraint can be evaluated. Finally, based on the improved IEEE33 node system, the proposed metrics and methods are verified, and the system resilience under different risks is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Parameters Equivalent Transformation Method for AC Filters in HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The commonly used double-tuned filter and triple-tuned filter in HVDC transmission system can usually be equivalent to the parallel single-tuned filters. The parameters of doubletuned filter and triple-tuned filter can be obtained from the parameters of parallel single-tuned filters by equivalent transformation. In addition, there is no model of double-tuned filter or triple-tuned filter in some common simulation software, which brought some difficulties to the harmonic analysis of HVDC. Therefore, it is significant to transform the double-tuned filter and the triple-tuned filter to the parallel single-tuned filters equivalently. Based on the circuit equivalence of double-tuned filter, triple-tuned filter and single-tuned filter, a parameters equivalent transformation method for AC filters in HVDC system is proposed. The forward and backward equivalent transformation formulas between the parameters of double-tuned filter, triple-tuned filter and parallel single-tuned filters are given respectively. Finally, examples are given to verify the feasibility and validity of the parameters equivalent transformation method for AC filters in HVDC system.

articleTitle: Defect diagnose of ultra-high voltage devices based on vibration monitoring method
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to monitor the abnormal state of an Ultra-high Voltage (UHV) reactor in real-time, vibration monitoring device was installed with vibration displacement, velocity and acceleration sensors attached on the equipment shell. It is detected that there is a non-core vibration source on the downlead side of the X-pillar iron core during the acetylene growth period. The disintegration results show that there is a significant phenomenon of discharge ablation on the downlead side of the X pillar ground-shield, which agrees with the analysis of vibration monitoring. It is proved that the vibration monitoring method is effective in the analysis and diagnosis of electrical equipment defects.

articleTitle: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF DISTRIBUTED TEMINAL REACTIVE POWER COMPENSATION ALGORITHM AND CONTROL SYSTEM FOR OFFSHORE OIL PLATFORM
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Offshore oil platform loads are mostly inductive loads, which absorb reactive power from the grid, which will increase the loss of the grid, and also have a certain impact on the grid voltage. In this paper, reactive power compensation is studied by switching capacitors on the load side, the requirements of capacitor switching conditions are analyzed, the design requirements of capacitor bank and capacitor controller are put forward, and the theoretical analysis is carried out.

articleTitle: Dual second-order generalized integrator based synchrophasor measurement and power-angle calculation under complicated grid conditions
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: As a power system dynamic monitoring device, phasor measurement units (PMUs) can collect system information and estimate the power angle of the generator. The commonly-used processing algorithm for PMU is the discrete Fourier transformation (DFT). However, due to the picket fence effect, the DFT algorithm has a poor accuracy of synchronous sampling under frequency deviation. In order to cope with the frequency deviation and the three-phase unbalance in measured signals, the dual second-order generalized integrator based Frequency-Locked Loop (DSOGI-FLL) is adopted in this paper to process the system signals. The DSOGI-FLL can improve the accuracy of the synchronous sampling by real-time frequency measurement. Meanwhile, the positive-sequence fundamental components of the system signal can be extracted by producing the orthogonal signals and filtering the harmonics. With the signals processed by the DSOGI-FLL, the power angle can be further estimated. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by comparing amplitude, phase and the power angle estimated by DSOGI-FLL with those estimated by DFT.

articleTitle: Safety analysis of entering equipotential on UHV transmission lines
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: UHV transmission lines have high operating parameters and electric field intensity around the lines. It is necessary to study the electric field distribution characteristics according to different tower type, and find the safe method of entering equipotential. In this paper, according to the typical tower structure of UHV transmission lines, we analyzed possible method of entering equipotential. The electric field distributions on the worker’s body under different conditions were analyzed by simulation, and the safety protection measures were put forward. The research shows that it is safe by the means of basket, insulating ladder or climbing through tension insulator-string. Then safety precautions were proposed for each of the method, and the precautions were proved safe and reliable through application, which can guide live working on UHV transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on the influence factors of lightning overvoltages of UHVDC grounding electrode lines
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: At present, the insulation design of the grounding electrode line is mainly based on 《the technical code for design of HVDC earth return operation system》 issued in 2014. Generally, the insulator is installed with a protective gap (arcing horn), and the insulator insulation configuration is designed according to power system with 35kV voltage level. Base on the technical code mentioned above, the insulation strength of grounding electrode line in UHVDC transmission project in China is relatively low, and the existence of arcing horn makes its lightning flashover rate higher than that of general 35kV Transmission line, which leads to frequent failure of grounding electrode line. Therefore, it is necessary to study the lightning overvoltage of grounding electrode to optimize the insulation configuration of the grounding electrode line. This paper mainly studies the lightning over-voltage level under different ground wire protection angle, soil resistivity and arcing angle. The relationship between the influence factors of overvoltage and the level of overvoltage is established, and the influence degree of each overvoltage factor on the over-voltage level is also studied. The measures to limit the lightning overvoltage of grounding electrode line are obtained. Under the same arcing horn, the relationship between the nominal height and the lightning withstanding level is nearly linear. Under the same nominal height, the relationship between the arcing horns and the lightning withstanding level is close to linear. For UHV DC grounding electrode lines, when the arcing angle is 600mm or more, the protection angle is not over 0 °, and the grounding resistance is not over 5 Ω, the lightning protection effect is the best. The research results will support the insulation design of UHV grounding electrode line.

articleTitle: Pole-to-pole short-circuit fault location for MMC-based DC distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the access of distributed energy and DC load, DC distribution system has more advantages than AC system. Fault location is one of the key technologies to ensure fast fault restoration in flexible DC distribution network. According to the fault transient characteristics of MMC-based DC distribution network after DC pole-to-pole fault, a fault location method based on initial stage after blocking sub-modules is proposed. The equivalent circuit of a two terminal DC distribution network was obtained and time-domain expressions of DC line current were deduced in this paper. The method uses current of DC line to calculate fault distance and transition resistance quickly, which is applicable under different grounding modes. This paper built a two terminal MMC-based DC distribution network in PSCAD/EMTDC and verified the fault location algorithm in MATLAB. Simulation results verify effectiveness of the proposed fault location method and its advantages in location accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the electrical topology design of high voltage and large capacity voltage source converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC grid technology based on flexible DC transmission provides new solutions to power problems such as large-scale renewable energy access, island transmission, and large city power supply. High voltage large capacity AC/DC converters and DC/DC converters have the functions of power conversion and power transfer, and are the core equipment for constructing a DC power grid. Aiming at the electrical topology of the high voltage large capacity voltage source converter, this paper proposes a topology design method based on the external voltage structure of the converter and the internal energy balance method. Firstly, the effect of the external voltage structure on the topology design is analysed. Secondly, the internal energy balance methods of the two types of converters are summarized, namely the multi-frequency method and the switching method. In this paper, a direct conversion DC/DC converter topology design is taken as an example, the application of this method is explained in detail, and the relationship between the external voltage structure of the converter and the internal energy balance is revealed.

articleTitle: Study on control strategy of large-scale renewable energy connect to LCC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: One of the important issues facing large-scale renewable energy development is to ensure the maximum consumption of large-scale renewable energy bases and the safe and stable operation of the power grid after connect. The research results show that when large-scale renewable energy generation is connected to the power grid, its volatility, randomness and intermittentness will have a certain impact on the system power balancing, reactive voltage and transient stability of the power grid. Renewable energy connect to LCC-HVDC is one of the commonly used long-distance large-scale power transmission methods. On the one hand, in order to ensure stable operation, the LCC-HVDC system needs to provide sufficient reactive power support for itself and the system. On the other hand, for large-scale renewable energy power stations, the collection lines are often long, and each renewable energy generator usually uses its own optimal operation as the control target, which causes reactive voltage control problems and harmonic amplification in the power station problem. Therefore, in order to coordinate the reactive power coordination and voltage regulation after the renewable energy is connected to the LCC-HVDC system, this paper studies the large-scale renewable energy power generation LCC-HVDC transmission connection and the supporting technology required for the development of renewable energy power generation. And the use of guidance is of great significance to help increase the accommodation space of large-scale renewable energy generation.

articleTitle: Research on power generation of PV DC microgrid based on electrochemical energy storage
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: An approach to overcome the fluctuation of power generation under the influence of temperature and light intensity by utilizing a hybrid electrochemical energy storage of photovoltaic (PV) DC microgrid system. It can perform peak load shifting of power generation. The I-V curves were formed from different light and temperature conditions by simulating the PV array mathematical model, and the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) of power generation was acquired with a modified disturbance observation method. We have devised a balanced energy storage strategy using a non-isolated bidirectional DC/DC converter connected to a DC bus and a hybrid electrochemical battery to achieve the management of battery. The double closed-loops improve the energy storage system, which the inner loop controls the battery current and the outer loop regulates the DC link voltage. To increase the generation power and solve the imbalance of power by storing the PV power generation in the energy storage battery. The acquired simulation and experiment results have demonstrated feasibility of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Parameter design and analysis of class E inverter for magnetically coupled resonant wireless power transmission system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: As the AC source input of magnetically coupled resonant wireless power transmission （ MCR-WPT ） system, the use of class E inverter can effectively simplify the circuit structure of the inverter, which has a broad application prospect in small MCR-WPT system. In the actual design process, the output performance of class E inverters is affected by the switching-parallel capacitor and resonant compensation capacitor of the MCR-WPT system, which makes the optimization design of the MCR-WPT system with class E inverters difficult. In this paper, the topology of MCR-WPT system with class E inverter is analyzed, in order to solve the problem that the class E system should work in the soft switching condition, this paper proposes a method about the parameter design of switching-parallel capacitor and resonant compensation capacitor, and finally the feasibility of the capacitance parameter of the proposed design method is verified by simulation and experiment. The simulation and experiment results show that the MCR-WPT system can realize the zero-voltage switching of class E switch when the resonant frequency is 300 kHz.

articleTitle: Commutation behaviour analysis of a 3L-ANPC-VSC phase-leg PEBB using 4.5kV and 3kA press-pack IGBT
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Three-level Neutral-Point-Clamped voltage source converter is extensively used in high-power and Medium-Voltage applications. 3L-ANPC-VSC was put forward to conquer the unequal losses distribution and supply redundant switch states for zero-level output by replacing the clamping diode with IGBT in 3L-NPC-VSC. The stray inductance takes an important role in the commutation path of the switching current during the switching event. This paper shows two stacking methods of press-pack IGBT 3L-ANPC unit busbar have been designed. The main differences between the two structures are the positions of clamping IGBT(T5 and T6). The total switching power losses for all commutation paths are analyzed. The stray inductance of all the commutation paths have been extracted by means of Three-Dimensional Finite-Elements-Analysis simulations based on the theoretical analysis,. The optimal structures are obtained by optimizing structure according to simulation results. The calculated values have been compared with simulation results obtained from the performance of double-pulse tests for each commutation path. This paper presents all the analysis details of the 3L-ANPC-VSC commutation behavior using 4.5kV and 3kA press-pack IGBT modules.

articleTitle: Effect of volatility of live line washing agents on physicochemical properties of silicon rubber for composite insulator
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The swelling characteristics of the contamination DC silicone rubber insulator under the Live Line Washing Agents (LLWA) have an important influence on its physical and chemical properties. Experimental research effects on the volatility, swelling and hydrophobicity of silicone rubber samples during live line washing processing with two different volatilization insulating agents. The results show that at 25℃, the volatilization rates of No.1 and No.2 washing agents were 104.63g/(h·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and1101.96g/(h·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). The degree of swelling of the silicone rubber increased with immersion time. The swelling reached saturation after 10 hours contacted with the insulating agent, and the silicone rubber swelled saturation indexes are respectively 130% and 55%. The washing agent No.1 has a weakening effect on the hydrophobicity of silicone rubber. After 10 minutes of washing process, the static contact angle decreases by about 14%. Washing agent No. 2 has a protective effect on the hydrophobicity of silicone rubber, and the static contact angle increases by 6%.Therefore, the highly volatile insulation washing agent can reduce the adverse effects of swelling on the silicone rubber insulator, and can provide a basis and reference for the live line washing of silicone rubber insulation equipment under energized operation.

articleTitle: Parametric design platform for power electronic switches in the hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: High-power solid-state switches are the key components of hybrid DC circuit breaker. At present, the application of solid state switches in hybrid DC circuit breakers needs to be highly customized. There is no design standard and mature experience to refer to, which limits the development and application of DC circuit breakers. In this paper, a parametric design platform for solid-state switch components in hybrid DC circuit breakers is established. The database is used to store functional characteristics and attributes of components, topologies, and other parameters. The type of solid-state switching devices, component topology, MOV parameters, and buffer branches are designed to meet the requirements of breaking voltage, breaking current, and energy dissipation. Finally, based on the parametric design platform, a 10kV IGCT component was developed and experimental tests were completed, which verified the accuracy and feasibility of the design platform.

articleTitle: Research on optimal dispatching strategy of regenerative electric heating in critical safety state of power grid
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, the optimal dispatching problem of regenerative electric heating in the critical safety state of the power grid is taken as the research object, and the operational constraints of the optimal dispatching of the regenerative electric heating in the critical safety state of the power grid are analysed, which include system operation constraints, grid constraints, access capacity constraints and load balancing constraints for regenerative electric heating users. Then the optimization goal of the regenerative electric heating operation under the critical safety state of the power grid is given. Furthermore, a regenerative electric heating load operation optimization dispatching model with the goal of guarantee heating during power outages under critical safety state of power grid is established and a simplex algorithm is used to solve the optimal dispatching model. The example shows that by optimizing the operation mode of the regenerative electric heating users under the critical safety state of power grid, the operating cost of the system can be effectively reduced and the load impact of the regenerative electric heating users on the upper distribution network can be reduced to ensure economical operation of the system on the premise of power grids safety.

articleTitle: Study on the lightning surge response of the AC side of UHVDC converter station based on finite difference time domain method
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to study the lightning surge characteristics of the AC side of the UHVDC converter station, a numerical calculation model based on finite difference time domain (FDTD) was established. The model considers the complex conductor structures and apparatus involved at the AC side of the UHVDC converter station. The electromagnetic coupling between the conductors due to lightning strokes can be estimated in 3D. The spatial and temporal evolution of the transient electric field of the converter station are obtained. The propagation process and variation characteristics of the lightning intruding overvoltage at different locations of the converter station are analyzed. In response to the unit ramp intrusion wave, the overvoltage level at the converter transformer and the busbar of the converter station is calculated. It is found that the overvoltage increases with the increase of the soil conductivity of the converter station ground, which can be provided as a reference for the insulation coordination design of the UHVDC converter stations.

articleTitle: Fault detection for equipment in distribution grid station house based on ubiquitous internet of things
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The fault detection device for the equipment in distribution grid station house collects information such as line operation state, line load and voltage through the mobile phone APP and has a real-time detection of line faults to realize on-line monitoring and analysis of distribution lines, which enables the operation and maintenance personnel to know about the line working at any time and provides data support for line perception, early warning and prediction, and auxiliary diagnosis. As the edge facility under the ubiquitous Internet of Things, the fault detection device connects the smart grid and the data from the ubiquitous Internet of Things, which creates an open and innovative data application ecology and provides data services for lean management of the distribution grid. It meets the requirements of "Research on Key Technologies of Sensors and Research and Development of Equipment", one of the five key technical research projects of the State Grid on strengthening the construction of Internet of Things in Power Systems. It is innovative in micro-power wireless communication technology, sensor energy collection technology, weak signal filtering and calculation.

articleTitle: DC conductivity characteristics of PEEK material at different temperatures and electric field intensities
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: This paper investigates the direct current (DC) conductivity of PEEK (polyetherketone) material that is used as packaging insulation materials of press pack IGBT devices under the electro-thermal composite stress. The DC conductivity is measured by polarization depolarization current method and corresponding experimental platform is setup in the laboratory. The temperature is controlled in the ranges of 15℃∼130℃, and the electric field intensities are controlled at the range of 10MV/m∼40MV/m. The effects of temperature and electric field intensity on the dc conductivity of PEEK materials are studied. The results show that the DC conductivity of PEEK material increases with the increase of temperature and electric field strength, respectively. The empirical formulas used to fit the relationship between the DC conductivity, temperature and electric field strength of PEEK material are proposed in this paper. The results can provide references for the packaging insulation design of press pack IGBT devices.

articleTitle: Study on scaling relationships of temperature rise in outdoor gas-insulated transmission line influenced by wind and solar radiation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The temperature characteristics of outdoor Gas-Insulated Transmission Line (GIL) are complicated because of the influence of wind and solar radiation. Scale modelling method is proposed to solve the constraints of temperature rise test based on prototype GIL, such as cost, time and site. Firstly, outdoor single-phase GIL temperature rise mechanism is analyzed considering wind and solar radiation. Then, the scaling relationships of all the physical processes correlated with temperature rise are analyzed, simplified and deduced systematically. Finally, scale model of outdoor GIL is built based on the scaling relationships derived. Transient temperature rise of the scale model in the case of wind and solar radiation are calculated and compared with that of the prototype by 3D finite element method. The correctness and effectiveness of the scale modelling method is validated by the comparison between calculated and test results.

articleTitle: Study on the application of neutral point reactor on UHV transformer to suppress short-circuit current
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the development of the power grid, the problem of excessive short-circuit current on the 500 kV side of the UHV substation gradually appears. In some UHV substations, the single-phase short-circuit current level exceeded the three-phase short circuit current. Installation of reactor on neutral point of transformer is one of the measures to suppress single-phase short-circuit current. This measure has been applied in 500 kV system, but few studies have been done on the neutral point reactor of UHV transformers. In this paper, application of neutral point reactor of transformer in UHV substation to limit single-phase short-circuit current is studied. The suppression effect of the neutral point reactor on the short-circuit current is studied based on typical autotransformers and system parameters. The overvoltage on neutral point of transformer in different operation and fault conditions were studied by simulation. The influence of neutral point reactor on the overvoltage and insulation level of neutral point is analyzed, and the limitation measures are proposed. With consideration of its suppressing effect on short-circuit current and influence on electromagnetic transient issues, the range of values of the neutral point reactor is proposed.

articleTitle: Challenge and key issue of wind turbine stability control under phase-locked dynamics
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Due to the inertia of power electronic equipment, weak overload capacity, and poor resistance to grid disturbances, the interaction between wind turbines and the grid in large-scale wind power enrichment areas is becoming more and more complex. Power system energy structure, electromagnetic characteristics, electromechanical characteristics, etc. all bring changes, and even the dynamic behaviour and stability mechanism of the entire power system may change significantly. Based on the development of wind power and the characteristics of the power grid in most parts of China, large-scale development of wind power is at the end of the grid with a weak grid structure. With the increase of the scale of wind power grid connection, the problem of large-scale wind power grid connection security and stability will persist for a long time and will only become increasingly prominent. Regardless of the sub-synchronous oscillation problem in some wind-rich regions, the oscillation process is complex, the oscillation frequency covers a wide range, and the oscillation mechanism is still unclear; or the fault ride-through capability that may exist in a relatively weak grid with a high proportion of wind power connected problems, the corresponding control improvement technology has not yet attracted attention. In this paper, the research status of wind turbine stability control is analyzed. Based on this, relevant control requirements, challenges and key issue are analyzed.

articleTitle: Protection configuration in distribution network with distributed PV integration
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In distribution networks, PV integration may cause maloperation or insufficient sensitivity of the protection under traditional protection configurations. This paper has investigated the impact of PV integration on the existing protections in distribution networks. An improvement scheme of protection configuration is proposed based on inverse time limit protection (ITLP) combined with the traditional protection configuration. The configuration strategy and setting methods of improvement scheme are introduced. A simulation model is established using DIGSILENT platform to verify the feasibility of the improvement scheme in five typical fault cases and the results indicate that the improvement scheme can ensure the correct operation of protection in different fault location.

articleTitle: Influence of CVT transient response on commutation process of DC transmission and improvement measures
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Capacitor voltage transformers (CVT) have been widely used in 220kV, 500kV HVDC transmission lines. The transient characteristics of CVT mainly show that when the primary side fails,the secondary side voltage can no longer be obtained simply from the primary side voltage according to the intermediate transformer conversion ratio, which will affect the commutation process of HVDC transmission system and even the frequency of commutation failure. This paper first establishes a simulation model in PSCAD/EMTDC with the actual parameters of the 500kV fast-saturated CVT, verifies its transient characteristics, and proposes a built-in series low-voltage capacitor C3 in the CVT to eliminate the output voltage error. The principle of commutation failure predictive control (CFPREV) is analyzed, and its input voltage has an impact on the commutation process of the DC system. Based on the Yi-hua DC model of East China Power Grid, the output voltages of CVT and CVT with C3 are used as input voltages for CFPREV. Simulation results show that the commutation results of CVT with C3 can be more accurate reflects the impact of AC bus faults on the inverter side on the DC system, and improves the speed and effectiveness of DC system recovery.

articleTitle: A 500kV Grid Background Harmonic Impedance Estimation Method Based on Different Operating Conditions of UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The UHVDC converter station is equipped with AC filters of different types and parameters, and its overall impedance-frequency characteristics are relatively complex. It can easily cause harmonic amplification by interaction with the grid impedance in some frequency range. For further analysis, the grid background harmonic impedance is needed. The equivalent harmonic analysis circuit for grid background harmonic impedance estimation is given. The 500 kV AC bus of UHVDC converter station is used as the PCC point. The harmonic voltage of AC bus and the harmonic current of converter transformer are taken as measurement data, and the data forms a measurement matrix. Then a 500kV grid background harmonic impedance estimation method based on different operating conditions of the converter station is proposed. The measurement matrix is decomposed by singularity value decomposition method, and the grid background harmonic impedance with grid background harmonic voltage is solved by least squares method. Finally, a PSCAD simulation model was built. The simulation results demonstrated the validity and practicality of this method.

articleTitle: Interface charge accumulation and decay characteristics of nano-TiO2 modified oil paperboard under DC and polarity reversal voltage
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Interface charge is a serious threat to the reliability of oil-paper insulation system in the converter transformer. In the recent researches, it is indicated that the paperboard modified by nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has excellent insulating properties, but the knowledge of interface charge accumulation and decay is still scarce. In this paper, the interface charge accumulation and decay characteristics of the paperboard modified by nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with different mass fractions were analysed under DC and polarity reversal voltage. The amplitude of the DC and polarity reversal voltage was 4kV. It indicates that the additive of nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has an inhibitory effect on the accumulation and decay of interface charge between the paperboard and oil. The decay behaviour of negative polarity is similar to that of positive polarity, and the 5% mass fraction is the best adding ration for the paperboard. What is more, the decay rate of the positive interface charge is faster than that of the negative one. In the polarity reversal experiment, the decay rate decreases with the increasing of the reversal time. This paper can provide a certain guiding significance for the electrical characteristics improvement of oil-immersed transformer insulation.

articleTitle: Study on impact of wind power on micro-grid operation and its control strategy
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: As one of the distributed generation in micro-grid (MG), the power characteristics of the asynchronous wind turbine (AWT) have a great influence on the operation stability of MG. In this paper, the equivalent circuit model of asynchronous generator is established, the characteristic relationship between the active/reactive power and the generator speed is analysed, and the influence of power fluctuation of AWT on the voltage stability of MG under the disturbance of wind speed is further analysed. On this basis, two control strategies, including the active/reactive current control and the active/reactive power control, are proposed for energy storage system based on voltage source converter structure and LCL filter, and the system simulation model of MG including AWT is built based on Matlab/Simulink, and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies is verified. The results show that in the process of wind speed disturbance, the energy storage system can quickly and accurately track the system power fluctuation, and provide the fast power output/input regulation. Then, the voltage and frequency fluctuation of MG is effectively suppressed after the energy storage system is configured.

articleTitle: A novel MVDC circuit breaker based on commutation path with double capacitors
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The current injection based mechanical DC circuit breakers (MDCCB) are widely applied for its superiority of low on-state losses and low cost. To realize full range current interruption and high dielectric recovery strength, a novel topology of MDCCB is proposed in this paper. The commutation path consists of two parallel capacitors, small capacitor for small current interruption, and small capacitor parallel with large capacitor for large current interruption. By using bridge type circuit, sufficient dielectric recovery time is provided. Moreover, interrupting characteristics under different combination of small and large capacitors is analysed by simulation. And the principle of optimal capacitors value assignment and the design method of breaking threshold current of using large capacitor are obtained. Finally, a simulation model is built to verify the proposed breaking scheme.

articleTitle: Research on influence factors of DC breakdown characteristics in gas discharge gap
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The DC breakdown voltage is an important guarantee for the reliability of the power supply system under normal operating conditions of the gas discharge gap. In order to accurately measure the DC breakdown voltage of the gas discharge gap, an experimental study and theoretical analysis of the factors affecting the DC breakdown voltage of the gas discharge gap were carried out. The experiment results show that when the rise rate of voltage is less than 1000V/s, the DC breakdown voltage and dispersibility of the gas discharge gap are rarely affected. On this basis, an equivalent model of the non-linear impedance of the gas discharge gap was established, and the partial voltage law of the nonlinear impedance of gas discharge gap and the series current-limiting resistor was obtained. In addition, through the finite element simulation of the gas discharge gap, the effect of the current limiting resistance on the DC breakdown voltage of the gas discharge gap was verified. The research results provide theoretical basis and experimental support for the accurate measurement of the DC breakdown voltage of the gas discharge gap.

articleTitle: Study on the role of DC partition in improving the stability of multi-infeed HVDC system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The establishment of the global energy interconnection can realize the large-scale optimal allocation of clean energy. The multi-infeed HVDC system can effectively solve the objective restrictions of the reverse distribution of load and energy, but the security and stability problems of the multi-infeed HVDC system are also increasingly prominent. In view of the lack of previous research on the global energy interconnection at home and abroad, this paper studies in detail the role of back-to-back MMC-HVDC partition in improving the safety and stability of the multi-infeed HVDC system in Denmark. First, the different partition modes of multi-infeed HVDC system are compared and analyzed. Then, based on the data of 2016 European main AC power grid, the European power grid is built and reconstructed in PSS/E, and MMC-HVDC links are used to replace two original large-capacity AC lines, forming the North-South division of Denmark. At last, the response characteristics of the system before and after DC partition are compared and analyzed. The simulation results show that the back-to-back MMC-HVDC partition can reduce the number of DC links suffering from commutation failure and narrow the fault range.

articleTitle: Development and experimental research of three-phase electric spring device
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Electric Spring (ES) in the power system can effectively alleviate the indirectness and randomness of new energy generation to the power grid. At present, there are few studies on development and experimental research of three-phase Electric Spring (3ph-ES) device. In this paper, the research and development of three-phase Electric Spring device are carried out. Firstly, the three-phase Electric Spring device and the main circuit parameters are designed based on the physical constraints and experimental goals. Secondly, a three-phase Electric Spring voltage stabilization control strategy based on PI control is proposed, and are verified by PSCAD / EMTDC platform simulation. Finally, a two-chip processing controller based on FPGA + DSP has established a three-phase Electric Spring experimental platform with a voltage level of 380V. The experimental results show that the designed three-phase Electric Spring device can effectively alleviate the voltage fluctuation. It provides a reference for the engineering application of three-phase Electric Spring.

articleTitle: Analysis on the safety and stability of flexible direct-current transmission technology in multi-infeed-direct-current receiving-end transmission power systems
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In the multi-infeed-direct-current receiving-end transmission power systems, because of the interactions among alternating-current (AC) and direct-current (DC) subsystems and large-scale infeed DC power, there exists many problems needing to be solved, such as insufficient voltage-support ability, standard-exceeding short-circuit current, probabilities of simultaneous commutation failures for multi-infeed DC channels caused by AC faults. With its fast and flexible power regulation, effective bus-voltage support and no induced additional short-circuit currents, flexible DC transmission technology has been widely used in long-distance large-capacity power transmission, system integration for long-distance large-scale offshore wind farm, asynchronous system construction and so on. As a typical multi-infeed-direct-current receiving-end transmission power system, the safety and stability of Jiangsu power grid has been threatened by the integrations of sharply increased large-scale DC infeed power and long-distance offshore wind farms. In this paper, affections from application of the flexible DC transmission technology to the safety and stability of Jiangsu power grid are analyzed from two aspects as short-circuit current and ability for voltage support. With application of the flexible DC transmission technology, it can not only to optimize the power flow distribution of Jiangsu power grid, but also effectively improve its safety and stability.

articleTitle: To extremely reduce the capacitance of STATCOM with controllable third harmonic voltage injection
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The cascaded-H-bridge-based static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) would contain the low order harmonic oscillation of the dc voltage per sub-module and therefore the larger dc capacitance would be utilized to prevent the overvoltage operation condition. The third harmonic control of STATCOM was further developed to effectively reduce the dc capacitance of CHB-based STATCOMs and meanwhile keep the identical inductive and capacitive reactive power compensation capability. By flexibly injecting the third harmonic voltage and controlling the averaged capacitor voltage simultaneously, the maximum capacitor voltage can be controlled in the allowable range and the dc capacitance can be reduced to half of traditional STATCOM’s capacitance. MATLAB simulations and experimental prototype verified the performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Inertia mechanism of two-stage photovoltaic grid connected power generation system based on coordinated control
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, the two-stage photovoltaic grid connected power generation system is taken as the research object. By analyzing the different inertia control functions on both sides of photovoltaic boost and inverter, a coordinated control strategy is proposed, and the influence of different parameters on the system inertia is analyzed by establishing the static synchronous generator model of the system. The results show that the virtual inertia of the two-stage photovoltaic grid connected power generation system mainly comes from the photovoltaic reserve capacity and the DC capacity of the inverter side. When the photovoltaic side responds to the grid frequency fluctuation, the lowest point of frequency drop is improved, the steady-state deviation of grid frequency becomes smaller, and the larger the sag coefficient is, the more obvious the improvement effect is, but the change rate of frequency does not change. When the inverter side responds to the grid frequency fluctuation, the grid frequency change rate becomes smaller, and the larger the droop coefficient is, the more obvious the improvement of the frequency change rate is, but the steady-state deviation of the grid frequency does not change. The coordinated control proposed in this paper makes good use of the advantages of the two response frequency fluctuations, so that the frequency change rate, the lowest point of frequency drop and the steady-state deviation of frequency are significantly improved, and the effect of frequency fluctuation suppression is the best.

articleTitle: Study on the fault ride through control for AC-DC hybrid distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Fault ride through control is an important technology for an efficient operation of AC/DC hybrid distribution network with multiple distributed energies. In this paper, a fault ride through control with energy storage is proposed, in which extra super capacitors is installed on the dc side of the power electronic transformer. The coordinated control of the super capacitors is designed. Meanwhile, the volume calculation of super capacitor is discussed. Finally, a model is established in MATLAB/Simulink and simulations are carried out. The results verify that the low voltage ride through ability of AC/DC hybrid distribution network is enhanced, and the output voltage of the DC side is more stable, with the auxiliary super capacitor.

articleTitle: Distributions of the electric field of stakpak IGBT submodule based on electricatic field simulation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The press pack-package for IGBT devices is more compatible with the serial application such as the converter valve. The Stakpak IGBT package, which is the preferred solution in HVDC apparatuses, shows the advantage in the pressure-balance of paralleled chips compared with the rigid press-pack package. It is necessary for insulation evaluation to investigate the characteristic of the electric field distribution in such a package, which may provide a reference for the design and modification of the package strategy. In this paper, we build the model of the Stakpak submodule with the practical structural details. The distribution of the electric field in the submodule is analyzed with the FEM method. As the first package with surface-covered silicone gel, the effect for covering thickness on electric field distribution is further simulated and analyzed. It is revealed that the field strength around the IGBT or FRD chips can be reduced with the silicone-gel covered. The reduction of the field strength is proportional to the thickness of the silicone gel.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of 252kV three-phase basin-type insulator
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Gas Insulated Metal Enclosed Transmission Line (GIL) has the characteristics of small floor space, large capacity and low loss. It is suitable for power transmission in complex environment and compact environment. In order to realize the miniaturized design of GIL, improve the natural power transmitted and cut production cost, the three-phase compact GIL will be applied gradually. However, when GIL is design as three-phase, the insulation distance is shortened and the electric field distortion becomes serious. In this paper, the full finite-element method (FEM) model of compact GIL was built and three types of basin type insulator were simulated and compared. The better design was obtained and the influence of the key parameters on electric field and stress distribution were analyzed. The result indicated that the design of basin structure should consider both electric and stress field. The conclusion could provide reference for the selection and design of three-phase basin-type insulator structure in 252 kV compact GIL.

articleTitle: Risk distribution of bird-related outage and typical faults analysis in Zhejiang power grid
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Bird-related outage of overhead transmission lines can be divided into bird nesting, bird excrement, and bird short-circuit. The main anti-bird devices include bird-repellent, bird-blocking, and bird-leading. Part of Zhejiang Province is a dense area of bird activity, and some lines are frequently disturbed by bird activities. This article comprehensively analyzes the geographical distribution of bird-related fault risks, typical bird-related failure cases, and related control measures in Zhejiang Power Grid Anatomy. Adhere to the "bionics" bird-proofing path, and in accordance with the concept of "upper and lower guides, coexistence of line birds, human and nature, and harmonious development", innovative use of "dangerous area installation of bird box blocking, safe area setting of bird cages" "Method, combined with high-density inspection and timely processing, can achieve effective control of bird-related faults.

articleTitle: Research on AC/DC hybrid power supply system in industrial park
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Generalized DC loads represented by inverter air conditioners, IT loads, and electric vehicle charging piles in southern China were growing rapidly. In order to meet the diversified energy demand of users, achieve multi-energy complementarity and improve power supply reliability. This article addressed the issues of typical energy demand and distributed renewable energy consumption in Southern Industrial Parks. An AC / DC hybrid power supply system in an industrial park scenario was proposed. The structure of dual power single bus and cluster concept were analyzed. The technical principles of key equipment such as power electronic transformers(PET) and fault current controllers in the system were described. Key technologies such as system operation control objectives, system operation control modes, and system operation control schemes were proposed. The system utilized multi-port power electronic transformers to achieve source, load, and storage access and complementary coordination, to achieve reliable access to high-penetration photovoltaics and economic energy supply for industrial loads and electric vehicle charging stations.

articleTitle: Development and test research of 10kv DC circuit breaker based on the principle of coupled negative voltage
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the increase of multi-terminal flexible DC distribution network projects, medium-voltage DC circuit breaker, as the key equipment to remove DC short-circuit fault, plays a key role in the operation reliability of the whole DC distribution network. In order to meet the engineering needs of DC distribution network, a 10kV hybrid DC circuit breaker based on the coupling negative voltage principle is developed in this paper. Firstly, the topology and working principle of the DC circuit breaker are introduced. Furthermore, the design scheme of key components including fast mechanical switch, power electronic switch and coupling negative voltage device is given. Finally, a 10kV hybrid DC circuit breaker prototype is developed and tested. The results show that the 10kV hybrid DC circuit breaker can break 15kA short circuit current within 2ms, and has the characteristics of low loss and high reliability.

articleTitle: Modelling analysis and simulation of a micro-grid using photovoltaic (PV) & battery based power generation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: One of the challenges in power distribution systems, it’s how to connect and control different types of generation into one station this called a Micro-Grid. The general idea for this paper is build a new simulation model for a Micro-Grid. Developing of renewable energy systems is an increase in the world because most types of resources for this generations need natural atmospheres such as the sun and air they are not harmful to the environment. A Micro-Grid is an electric grid that contains all types of generations (distributed generations, energy storage system devices and different loads). In this paper we discuss by steps modelling, analysis and control of Micro-Grid consists PV array, Battery storage, DC/DC converter, DC/AC inverter and controller with various loads (RLC & RL load) in MATLAB-SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Investigation on fault energy dissipation for MVDC distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The medium voltage direct current (MVDC) power distribution system is the promising direction of the future distribution network. However, there exist some problems including large fault current, high short-circuit energy and long energy dissipation time, which restrict the development of DC distribution network. Therefore, this paper studies the key issues of fault energy dissipation in MVDC distribution system. By comparing the differences between different current limiting and breaking schemes and analysing the distribution and dissipation characteristics of the system short-circuit energy, the key factors affecting the short-circuit energy and energy dissipation time are extracted. Then the simulation cases based on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform are performed to verify the influence of different current limiting-breaking schemes and system parameters on energy dissipation results. Furthermore, by optimizing the parameter coordination between the converter, the fault current limiter (FCL) and the DC circuit breaker (DCCB), the capacity requirement of the energy dissipation module of DCCB is further reduced, and the short-circuit fault energy is quickly dissipated.

articleTitle: Improved deep reinforcement learning based convergence adjustment method for power flow calculation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The Power Flow Convergence (PFC) adjustment is an essential issue in the study of power system Operation State Calculation (OSC). Currently, as the grid structure expands markedly, the PFC adjustment is realized by adjusting the regional active and reactive power manually in most dispatching centres, which is tedious and personnel-experience oriented. Therefore, it is crucial to automate the PFC adjustment for efficiency and quality improvement. In this paper, an improved deep reinforcement learning (IDRL) based method and an action-executing strategy are proposed for the automation of the PFC adjustment. The optimal configuration scheme of the adjustable generators is derived from the trained online Q network for multi-load levels. Finally, the testing results on the IEEE-118 bus system demonstrate that the proposed method can obtain the convergent power flow state according to the given load level effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis on causes and prevention measures of Corona noise in substation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Corona noise has become an important part of noise in substations, especially in areas with severe operating conditions such as high winds, sand and dust. UV imaging detection technology can effectively find corona discharges on the surface of substation fittings. In this paper, by analyzing the test results of corona noise and ultraviolet imaging of typical fittings of 500kV substations, the main corona noise generating areas in the substation 500kV area are found. Based on the commonly used fitting structures, improvement measures are given for areas prone to corona noise. The results can provide a basis for corona noise control in 500kV substation.

articleTitle: A short-term prediction method of wind power based on improved fuzzy C-mean soft clustering
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of randomness and volatility in wind power forecasting, a short-term prediction method of wind power based on improved fuzzy C-mean soft clustering is proposed. In this method. First, the data of historical power and data of numerical weather forecast are clustered respectively. Second, subsets of samples are combined according to the time continuum principle. Finally, multiple neural network prediction models are established according to cassification modeling idea. The data of the subset of samples belonging to the prediction point is taken as the training data, then the power value of the prediction period is predicted. The proposed method is applied to the actual wind power forecasting. The results show that the accuracy of short-term wind power forecasting is improved by using the proposed method.

articleTitle: COIL OPTIMIZATION DESIGN OF THE HORN SHAPE FOR UNDERWATER WIRELESS POWER TRANSFER
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In the application scenarios of underwater wireless power transfer (WPT), a horn shape coil is proposed in this paper. Aiming to obtain the uniform magnetic field in a specific area, the horn shape coil is optimized by reasonably setting the tilt angle and the spacing of the turns. Moreover, the horn coil with optimal tilt angle and the horn coil with uneven spacing are designed. Considering the eddy current loss in seawater, the model of WPT system in seawater is established using the 3D electromagnetic simulator. Through simulation and analysis of eddy current loss under different conditions, the influence of eddy current loss on efficiency is illustrated. Finally, the transfer efficiency and output power are obtained by simulation and calculation. Also, the performance of the designed system is evaluated. It is found that the proposed system can effectively enhance the stability and anti-offset capability of WPT system, and then obtain the stable and efficient output.

articleTitle: Asset management of power transformer: optimization of transformer liftime cost based on quality management strategy
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In this paper, asset management based on quality management strategy of power transformer are made, in order to determine the optimal transformer lifetime cost, i.e. the minimization of construction, operating and maintenance costs. The strategy for the quality management consists of ageing mechanisms of transformer manufacturing materials, evaluation of robustness for transformer in service, transformer rating based on quality sensitivity, and optimization of asset management strategy based on status of transformer. By identify the influencing factor and ageing curve of different kinds of materials, the reliability of a single power transformers from partial to full scale can be evaluated, which determine the initial value of quality-related costs for power transformers in service. This initial value is set as universal for the following condition assessment of all power transformers in the same cluster during the entire lifetime. After the ranking for power transformers depending on the operating state is determined, the residual value of quality-related costs at the end of lifetime is calculated, which can be used for optimizing the asset management strategy for power transformers takes the quality management as the core object. The proposed method is feasible for other large high voltage equipment in power network.

articleTitle: A control and protection scheme of DC collection Grid-Connected system for solar photovoltaic plants
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: At present, solar photovoltaic plants mainly adopt AC collection grid-connected systems, with simple control methods and large transmission loss, which is not conducive to long-distance transmission of power. Meanwhile, the DC Collection Grid-Connected System (DCCGS) has flexible control modes and higher transmission efficiency. DCCGS consists of DC collection system and DC grid-connected system with different voltage levels, including multiple DC loops and various inverters. The existing AC or DC protection cannot be directly applied to DCCGS. It is necessary to analyse the fault characteristics of DCCGS and propose a new type protection. The DCCGS control and protection scheme proposed in this dissertation can effectively improve the operational reliability of solar photovoltaic plants, and lays a solid foundation for further research on DCCGS collaborative control.

articleTitle: Modeling of power system with converter elements in lyapunov direct method based on time scale selection
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The power electronic trend of power system is more and more obvious, which brings more challenges to the application of traditional Lyapunov direct method in transient analysis of power system. Fortunately, the Lyapunov function method based on Sum-Of-Squares optimization greatly reduces the difficulty of constructing Lyapunov function by the traditional one. However, this method is sensitive to the order of system, and the dimension disaster will occur in higher-order systems.To solve the above problems, this paper explores an idea that, firstly based on the theory of multiple time scale the converter element model is divided into two subsystems of different time scales, and by solving the eigenvalues of the state equations, fast and slow subsystems are identified and then the former is ignored to realize the order reduction. The rationality of the order reduction method is verified by contrasting the dynamic characteristics of the original model and the reduced order model with time-domain simulation.
