Further, the Lyapunov function of reduced order model is constructed by Lyapunov function method based on Sum-Of-Squares optimization. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is tested on three-machine-ten-bus AC/DC system with the wind power module in matlab platform.

articleTitle: Digital-analog hybrid dynamic simulation test method and platform for hybrid DC circuit breakers
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The Zhangbei DC grid project is the world's first DC grid project, which comprises 14 hybrid DC circuit breakers. The hybrid DC circuit breakers usually include power electronic modules, ultra-high-speed mechanical switches, power supply system, water cooling systems, OCT (Optical Current Transformer) and other auxiliary equipment. The control and protection equipment of the hybrid DC circuit breaker has complex functions, huge number of interfaces to connect other devices, many functional test items, and lacks effective testing methods. In this paper, a digital-analog testing method for control and protection equipment of hybrid DC circuit breaker is presented. Then, the detailed design methods of the digital simulation part and the analog simulation part are described respectively. The simulation methods of OCT, fast mechanical switch, power supply system and other equipment in the dynamic simulation test platform are introduced. A hybrid dynamic simulation test platform for hybrid DC circuit breaker is developed, and the function tests of DC circuit breaker control and protection equipment are completed on this platform. The test platform is highly equivalent and can satisfy the full-function test demand of DC circuit breaker control and protection system. It provides an effective verification means for control and protection equipment of hybrid DC circuit breaker for Zhangbei DC grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of insulation state on body feeling under the AC and DC transmission line
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The body feeling of different insulation effects under AC and DC transmission line is analyzed in this paper. The results could provide a reference for evaluating the electromagnetic environment of AC and DC transmission lines. Firstly, the different types of the body feeling under AC and DC transmission lines is analyzed. The main body feeling under the AC electric fields is the steady-state feeling of the body in the electric fields. The main body feeling under the DC transmission line is the transient electric shock. Secondly, an three-dimensional finite element model of transmission lines and a simplified human body model is established in COMSOL. This paper calculated the induced potential, induced current density and electric field of the human body under different states of insulation. The result shows that wearing the shoes make the body induced voltage increase significantly. Finally, the transient electric shock of different insulation states under the DC transmission line is analyzed in this paper. The model of DC transmission line and human body is built in the laboratory, and the transient electric shock under different insulation states is simulated. The body's discharging waveform can be used to evaluate the body feeling. The experiment results can provide technical support for the safe operation and maintenance of DC transmission lines.

articleTitle: A practical model for stability analysis of modular multilevel converters
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been adopted by many practical engineerings in both the high voltage DC transmission field and the medium voltage DC distribution field because of its outstanding advantages. However, the stability analysis of MMC should be studied further to keep the stable operation of the MMC based DC system. Firstly, the topology of the MMC is introduced in detail. And then the practical model for stability analysis of MMC is proposed by establishing the mathematical model for MMC. The MMC could be simplifed into a parallel connection model of a controllable current source and its equivalent capacitor. Finally, case study of a MMC based DC system is conducted and the simulation has been performed in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the effectiveness of the proposed practical model of MMC.

articleTitle: Harmonic compensation control strategy based on adaptive virtual impedance for inverter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: When microgrid operates in island mode, the harmonic pollution will be resulted because of the nonlinear loads. In order to solve the problem of harmonic pollution during the island operation of microgrid and realize the power sharing averagely between the paralleled inverters at the same time. A control method based on model reference adaptive virtual impedance is proposed. A harmonic sorting compensation strategy is used. By detecting the harmonic voltage, that is injected into the model reference adaptive control loop. Then in the model reference adaptive control loop, the difference between the feedback voltage and the output voltage can be calculated. The obtained voltage difference is separated according to the frequency band. And the result is sent to the adaptive mechanism, then the virtual resistance of each harmonic frequency band can be dynamically adjusted to complete the purpose of harmonic compensation in the system. A simulation platform is built in SIMULINK. The validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Study on the difference of current throughflow characteristic of UHV transmission line tower’s grounding body
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to study the current throughflow characteristic of the transmission line towers’ grounding body of different AC UHV grades under lightning strikes and short-circuit faults, this paper uses ATP-EMTP to simulate lightning strikes and short-circuit faults on typical lines of 1000kV, focusing on the current amplitude and capacity flowing through the grounding body under the above two faults. The results show that when a lightning strike occurs, the current amplitude flowing through the grounding body is only related to the lightning current amplitude and the resistance of the grounding body, and has nothing to do with the position where lightning strikes along the line; when a short-circuit fault occurs, the current amplitude and capacity flowing through the grounding body are related to the body's resistance, transmission capacity, and fault location. This research has a great guiding effect on the selection of the grounding body of the line tower, and also has great reference value for the application of other new materials such as flexible graphite grounding bodies.

articleTitle: Influences of air pressure, temperature and humidity on the electric field in air insulation: Their characteristics, mechanism and fitting formula
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The UHVDC projects develop rapidly and have already extended to high altitudes, thus the converter transformers, the key equipment of UHVDC, should be assembled and tested locally (at high altitudes) for convenience, economy and accuracy. The high altitude brings difficulty to the routine test for UHV converter transformer, especially the external air insulation of test equipment needs to be optimized according to altitude (air pressure, temperature, humidity). Therefore, the effect of altitude on the electric field in air insulation is studied in our work considering the charge distribution via a simplified simulation model, and the influence mechanism is discussed, it is found that the maximum electric field intensity has a positive correlation with temperature, but a negative correlation with air pressure or humidity, in which the air pressure has the greatest effect. On this basis, the formula for the maximum electric field intensity with altitude is fitted, and its accuracy is verified via a simulation model of the HV reactor, this formula can guide the correction of electric field intensity in air insulation according to altitudes and provide the basis for insulation structure optimization of the equipment used in the routine test for converter transformers at high altitudes.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization design technology of regional integrated energy system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In a certain area, the regional integrated energy system integrates coal, oil, natural gas, electrical energy, thermal energy, hydrogen energy, mechanical energy and other energy sources to achieve coordinated planning, optimized operation, collaborative management, and multi-energy complementarity. The ultimate goal of the regional integrated energy system is to improve the efficiency of energy comprehensive utilization. Firstly, the key elements such as electricity, gas, cold and heat in the regional integrated energy system are modeled and the mutual coupling techniques are studied. Then the comprehensive evaluation indicators and evaluation methods for the regional integrated energy system are established. The objectives of optimization includes energy supply reliability, energy quality, economic benefits, energy conservation, emission reduction, grid friendliness, program adaptability, and so on. Meanwhile, the planning and design of the system architecture is researched, determining the optimal energy types and energy ratios in the regional integrated energy systems. Based on the above analyses, multi-objective optimization of the regional integrated energy system are conducted using nonlinear optimization method. The obtained results are evaluated according to the evaluation indicators from the technical and economic aspects.

articleTitle: Research on the converter temporarily blocking strategy during the AC fault of the MMC-HVDC link
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The paper focuses on the converter temporarily blocking strategy during the ac fault of the MMC-HVDC link. The ac fault-ride through strategy of MMC-HVDC, including fault detection, power limitation, power recovery, are fully studied. Due to the limited overcurrent tolerance of the MMC modules, the converter may need to be blocked temporarily in the transient process before control system could fully response, in case of damaging to the IGBTs. Three feasible kinds of temporarily blocking strategies are studied, and the impact on the active/reactive power, arm current, dc voltage and current are also compared in this paper. A high fidelity real-time model for all three control strategies are developed based on the actual control system of Yu’E back-to-back dc grid interconnection project, which is the largest MMC-HVDC project and links two separated AC networks, Simulation results could fully verifies the analysis of all three blocking strategies, and the best strategy is recommended.

articleTitle: A study on the application of temperature measuring technology for magnetic-valves in a magnetic-valve controlled reactance
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: According to practical cases of MCR abnormal operation and breakdown disintegration, this paper makes an investigation into the partial overheating characteristic of magnetic valves pre-set on the MCR iron core. To describe temperature rising performances of magnetic valves inside 35kV oil-immersed MCR, this paper developed a kind of fluorescent optical-fiber sensor-based temperature monitoring system and proposed the installation method for field applications. All proposed technologies were applied and tested at a 220kV substation. After a long-term field-trial, all collected data results proved that proposed temperature monitoring system and installation methods could achieve long-term, reliable, and accurate on-line temperature monitoring for hot spots on magnetic-valves, which brings great help for improving operation reliability and maintenance level of the MCR.

articleTitle: Application of SVG to mitigate voltage sag in energizing no-load transformer
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the rapid growth of economics, power quality issue represented by voltage sag has increasingly captured considerable attention from both utility companies and their customers. Continuous voltage sag results in the operation of under voltage load shedding (UVLS), seriously influencing the system security and service reliability. Based on energizing typical 1000 kV no-load transformer located in UHV network in North China Power Grid, the mechanism of voltage sag caused by energizing no-load transformer was analysed and it was proposed that the inrush current was an important factor influencing the voltage sag. The voltage sag caused by the oscillating inrush current is discussed. And the influence factors and suppression measures on the voltage sag are studied. It is proposed to install large-capacity dynamic reactive power compensation device Static Var Generator (SVG) to mitigate voltage sag in energizing no-load transformer. And to verify the effectiveness of SVG to mitigate voltage sag in energizing no-load transformer, a typical model of the analysis system based on PSCAD/EMTDC has been built, both theoretical analysis and simulation results show that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on power supply reliability assessment of grid-connected microgrid
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The power supply reliability assessment of microgrid can guide the planning and construction of the system. Fluctuation and power supply supporting effect of distributed generation increase the difficulty and complexity of power supply reliability assessment of the system. In this paper, a power supply reliability assessment method for grid-connected microgrid is proposed. Firstly, evaluation indexes of power supply reliability for microgrid system is introduced. Then, prediction models for distributed generation output and load demand forecasting are established. State sequences of each element in the system are generated by using sequential Monte Carlo method. The power supply reliability result of the whole system can be obtained based on the interruption duration analysis of each load, by using predicted powers of the distributed generations and loads, and remaining capacity of energy storage, which takes load priority into consideration. Finally, a typical case study is carried out by MATLAB simulation in an AC/DC hybrid microgrid, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of safe maintenance methods for 750kV four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The abstract should be suitable for direct inclusion in ABSTRACT: With the construction and development of the power grid in northwest China, 750kV four-circuit tower construction has become the optimal solution to the shortage problem of transmission line corridors. In order to ensure the safety of the maintenance of 750kV four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower, this paper makes a 1:1 simulation tower head according to the four-layer cross arm structure of the four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower. The gap discharge characteristics of the four-circuit transmission lines on the same tower under special live working conditions are obtained through tests. The minimum safe distances of the equipotential operators on the side of the tower to the tower body and the lower cross arm are determined to be 4.2m and 4.3m respectively, the minimum safe distance between phases is 5.8m, and the minimum combined gap distance between phases of the equipotential combination of the conductors entering and leaving the outside phase is 6.3m;;The simulation modeling calculation is used to obtain the maximum induced voltage of 64.5kV when both ends of the power-off line are not grounded, the maximum induced voltage after both ends are grounded is in the range of 114V-195V, and the maximum induced current peak value in the circuit is in the range of 0.57A-1.5A when some circuits of the same tower four-circuit line are powered off and overhauled. The research results of this paper can provide technical support for the safe maintenance of 750kV four-circuit lines on the same tower.

articleTitle: Factory experimental study on withstand voltage and synchronous partial discharge of 500 kV cross-linked submarine cable
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: High-voltage cross-linked insulated submarine cable is different in structure from terrestrial cable, and the seawater medium is used as the external grounding, which bring greatly difficulty in partial discharge signal sensing inside the submarine cable. In this paper, based on the test method and characteristics of large-length cross-linked submarine cable, the factory withstand voltage and synchronous partial discharge test scheme for semi-finished and finished 500 kV cross-linked submarine cable are proposed, and the principle of external partial discharge sensor layout based on capacitive coupling method is determined. The full coverage of the partial discharge detection of the 18km long submarine cable is realized, and the effect of the sensor layout is verified. It is beneficial to improve the test technology of large-length and large-section cross-linked submarine cable and improve the status evaluation level of running submarine cable.

articleTitle: A hybrid electric field calculation method for UHVAC and UHVDC transmission lines parallel adjacent erection
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: UHVAC and UHVDC transmission lines erect in the same corridors can solve the problem of insufficient transmission corridors in China, but it is difficult to solve the hybrid electric field under UHVAC and UHVDC transmission lines in the same corridors accurately and efficiently with existing algorithms. This paper proposes an algorithm based on the Deutsch assumption that an ac conductor at any time can be regarded as a dc conductor whose voltage value is the instantaneous value of ac voltage, thus simplifying the ac and dc transmission line parallel adjacent erection problem to a multi-loop dc transmission line problem. At the same time, the dc offset charge parameters and ac ripple charge parameters are introduced to improve the calculation accuracy, because It reflects the distribution law of ground electric field in practical UHVAC and UHVDC transmission lines in the same corridors. Take a transmission lines of ±800kV dc and 1000kV ac in the same corridor as an example, and compare the algorithm value with the measured value. The results show that the average error between the algorithm value and the measured value is only 7.2%, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A test circuit for simulating lightning strikes on HVDC transmission lines
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The impulse corona characteristics is an important influence factor in lightning protection. When lightning strikes on the DC transmission lines, space charges near the lines will affect the impulse corona, so it is necessary to study the impulse corona characteristics in the ion flow field. This paper proposed a mixed DC-impulse voltage-applying circuit to simulating the process of the lightning striking on the DC transmission lines. When the impulse voltage is not applied, the voltage on the line is the DC voltage. When the impulse voltage is applied, the voltage on the line is a superposition of the DC and the impulse voltages. Both the PSCAD simulation results and the reduced-scale test results verify the effectiveness of the circuit.

articleTitle: Optimal operation and energy storage mode analysis of integrated energy system considering uncertainty of renewable energy output
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Renewable energy(RE) and energy storage system(ESS) are important parts for future integrated energy system(IES). The optimal operation of IESs faces great challenges with high percentage of RE with uncertainty and energy storage(ES) integration. However, the impact of uncertainty of RE output and ES modes on optimal operation of IES has not been clearly investigated yet. In this paper, an optimal operation method which takes the uncertainty of RE output into account is proposed. And the impact of ES modes on economics of IES is analysed. Firstly, the uncertainty model of RE and loads are established based on the probabilistic scenario method. And the IES model including ESS is proposed. Then the differential evolution(DE) optimization method is utilized to solve the optimal equipment capacity with minimum overall cost. Based on this, the second-order cone optimization method is applied to solve the optimal operation strategy. Moreover, the interactions of ES equipment in different modes including single ES and hybrid ES are investigated thoroughly. And the economics of IES under different ES modes are discussed in detail. Finally, the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method are verified by simulations. And the suggestions on ES configuration are made.

articleTitle: Research of economic evaluation methods on multi-platform power system in offshore oil field
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Economic evaluation of interconnected power systems on offshore oil platforms has valuable meaning on oil exploitation, but no effective method has been proposed yet. This paper presents an overall review combining energy economics and distribution network evaluation methods to analyse the construction cost and production efficiency of the offshore power system with regard to the oil deposits and production planning in different periods. Based on the DD&A(depreciation, depletion, amortization) cost of barrel oil commonly used in the petroleum industry, the electrical DD&A cost of barrel oil was proposed for the first time to evaluate the economic performance of different power system topology . In terms of the index weight of economic evaluation methods, analytic hierarchy process is used to establish the subjective weight and the entropy weight method is used to establish the objective weight, this two weights are then compounded by using ideal point method. Finally, this paper takes an offshore oilfield in Bohai as example to verify the performance of the economic evaluation method, which is used to assess different power system topology in long-term planning. Results of the true case indicate that the method can evaluate the interconnected power systems effectively.

articleTitle: Review on voltage sag of distribution network under multiplex fusion
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Among all kinds of power quality problems, voltage sag has the most serious impact on the production of users. In recent years, the research on voltage sag is one of the hotspots in the field of power quality. This paper systematically analyses the causes of voltage sag and its typical characteristics; By comparing and analyzing the existing optimal allocation methods of voltage sag monitoring points, it is pointed out that the current optimal allocation of voltage sag monitoring points generally depends heavily on voltage sag threshold and neglects fault resistance; The time-frequency analysis method and non-time-frequency analysis method in voltage sag detection are elaborated. The shortcomings of current voltage sag detection methods are pointed out. The advantages and disadvantages of improved S-transform are compared and analyzed emphatically; This paper analyses the methods of voltage sag control from three aspects: power supply side, user side and equipment manufacturer side. It is proposed that the integrated control based on the relationship between the three methods is more effective, and the research on the integrated control of voltage sag is prospected.

articleTitle: Capacity configuration and coordinated control of synchronous condensers with capacitors and reactors
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: HVDC transmission systems have developed rapidly in recent years, which is suitable for the unbalanced distribution of power generation and power load in China. At the same time, system’s demand for large-capacity dynamic reactive power has gradually increased. In order to improve the dynamic reactive power support capability of HVDC systems, new-generation synchronous condensers (SCs) are installed in HVDC converter stations. To increase the steady-state reactive power margin of the SC and make full use of its transient reactive power support capability, this paper proposes the capacity configuration and coordinated control methods of the SC and reactive power compensation devices in HVDC converter station. These reactive power compensation devices are different from filter banks in the HVDC converter station. They are capacitors or reactors, which are additionally configured for the SC to improve its steady and dynamic performance. A simulation model is built on PSCAD platform, which verifies the effectiveness of the capacity configuration and coordinated control proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of protection resistor for large-scale DC voltage generator
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In the test of superimposing the impulse voltage under the action of the DC voltage, in order to protect the DC voltage generator from being damaged by the impulse voltage, a special resistance element needs to be designed to be installed in the test circuit to protect the DC generator. In this paper, through simulation calculations, the resistance value of the protective resistor in the DC superimposed impulse voltage test circuit and the structure of the terminal grading ring are selected and optimized. The results show that under the maximum 900kV DC superimposed 1800kV operation or 2400kV lightning impulse voltage The protection resistor is 800kΩ, which can meet the role of protecting the DC voltage generator in the test circuit. The high-voltage end of the protection resistor is equipped with a voltage equalizing ring with a ring diameter of 2700mm, a pipe diameter of 250mm, and a cover depth of 500mm, which can significantly improve the protective resistance potential and electric field Distribution to prevent flashing of the external resistance of the protective resistor.

articleTitle: Fault analysis of preinsertion resistors for circuit breakers used in 750kV ACF
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to diagnose the intermittent partial discharge defects of preinsertion resistors in the circuit breaker timely, the circuit breaker with an abnormal closing condition is detected with partial discharge in the closing state and the running state respectively. According to the result of live detection, the dynamic resistance method is adopted to fit the closing current. A method for detecting the intermittent partial discharge defects of circuit breakers with preinsertion resistors during operation is proposed. By analyzing the electromagnetic field simulation, fast transient overvoltage simulation and thermal capacity test results of the normally disintegrated preinsertion resistors, two kinds of defect improvement measures for the circuit breaker with preinsertion resistors are proposed, which can effectively avoid flashover accidents caused by intermittent discharge of preinsertion resistors.

articleTitle: Analysis of contamination characteristics of converter station and development of portable salt density measuring device
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The contamination characteristic of high voltage electrical equipment is directly related to its insulation performance. In this paper, the contamination degree and components of two HVDC converter stations in coastal and inland areas are measured, their contamination outdoor insulation characteristics are analyzed in combination with geographical environment, meteorological conditions and the pollution sources in the vicinity. On this basis, a portable salt density measuring device is developed, which can measure the equivalent salt density of insulators in the field, greatly reduce the cost of measurement, improve the detection efficiency, and can be popularized in the field of pollution measurement of outdoor high-voltage electrical equipment.

articleTitle: The improvement of real-time dynamic phasor simulation to transient process of LCC-HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to realize the coordination of relay protection in High Voltage AC/DC hybrid system, it is critical to quantify and summarize the characteristic of fault current form DC inverter side in real-time, therefore, our article proposed high accuracy, generic voltage switching function and current switching function in the form of dynamic phasor, which are able to describe unsymmetrical switching operations and commutation failures. A multi-fault scenes tests were conducted against mature electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD to verify the computation time and accuracy of our modified real-time Dynamic Phasor Modelling (DPM), which show promising results that our model can be easily implemented in online commutation failure forecasting, online power system protection setting or speed-up simulation considering commutation failures.

articleTitle: Overvoltage analysis of flexible HVDC converter station
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to solve the impact of photovoltaic volatility on power systems, flexible HVDC transmission technology is more and more used for photovoltaic grid connection. As the most important component of flexible HVDC transmission systems, the characteristics of the equipment in the flexible HVDC converter station are of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the HVDC transmission system. When the AC/DC side of the converter station fails or is struck by lightning, the converter station equipment will have an overvoltage. In severe cases, it will damage the equipment in the converter station and threaten the safe and stable operation of the system. Therefore, this paper comprehensively considers the various overvoltage conditions of a ±30kV converter station with modular multilevel converter (MMC), and uses PSCAD/EMTDC for simulation calculation. According to the calculation results, the arrester configuration of the converter station is analysed, and the results can be used for equipment selection and engineering design.

articleTitle: Estimation of VFTO caused by same frequency and phase withstand voltage test of GIS
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The same frequency and phase withstand voltage test of GIS has been applied in the transition test of substation expansion. However, when the breakdown accident occurs in the test process, the VFTO will seriously threaten the safety of the tested equipment and operating equipment. Aiming at a same frequency and phase withstand voltage test of GIS, EMTP simulation model is established and the parameters are determined. The VFTO that may occur in the GIS under different operation modes and different test conditions are studied. The restraint effect of the test protection resistance on the VFTO is analyzed, and the corresponding measures for safety are given. The results demonstrate that different operation modes of the tested GIS system will produce different VFTO. When the single breakdown is changed to ground flashover, the over-voltage amplitude of the non-tested bus node will increase, and the over-current of the break will also increase. The conventional test protection resistance cannot restrain the VFTO. The test state sensing measures and other safety measures need to be implemented in the test.

articleTitle: A fast setting method for optimal re-closing time of high voltage transmission line
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: This article proposes the transient energy model of multi-disturbance sequence, which is composed by the permanent fault and re-closing. The influence of re-closing time on the system transient stability is analyzed based on the stability margin. In this paper, a fast setting method for optimal re-closing time based on short-circuit fault trajectory is proposed. This method takes the minimum angular velocity as the initial tuning value and calculates the optimal re-closing time quickly by iterative correction of the second order sensitivity of the stability margin refer to Newton’s method. The IEEE test system case verifies the efficiency and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Resonance analysis of wind power integration via MMC-HVDC based on frequency-coupled impedance scanning method
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The risk of resonances in the frequency range of several hertz to several hundred Hertz may occur in wind farms integration via MMC-HVDC. Stability of wind power integration via MMC-HVDC based on frequency-coupled impedance scanning method is analysed in this paper. First, a frequency-coupled impedance analysis method that is used to measure the sequence impedance models of wind power integration via MMC-HVDC is presented. Then, the network damping stability criterion and aggregated RLC circuit approach is applied for the quantitative assessment of potential resonance risk. Finally, impedance characteristic and stability assessment of doubly-fed induction generator-based wind farms integration via MMC-HVDC is analysed for the resonances in sub/super-synchronous frequency band, medium frequency band and high frequency band respectively.

articleTitle: The influence of circuit breaker operation on the mal operation of relay protection device
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: This paper describes an incident of the 110kV-breaker’s mal operation. The possibility of multiple arc extinguishing is analysed when circuit breaker disconnects short circuit current and the overvoltage mechanism of bus bar and transformer ungrounded neutral point caused by arc extinguishing during operation of circuit breaker is analysed in depth. Based on the structure of a 110 kV distribution network, according to the characteristics of electrical parameters and load current when short circuit occurs, the arc model is established. By analysing the characteristics of over-voltage produced by circuit breakers operating at different speeds, the reasons of mal operation of relay protection are analysed. the relaying will mal operate when the transformer neutral zero-sequence current path changes by circuit breaker operation, and zero-sequence current protection will operate when grounding fault occurs on the protected line which is not expected by the relaying design. Simulation proves that the 110kV transformer’s neutral point potential can be decreased to avoid the neutral breakdown a by adopting new types of breaker with faster moving contacts or higher pressure arc-quenching medium. The proposed method can improve the power supply reliability of 110 kV transmission line at the end of distribution network.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of ±10kv MMC based grid-connected converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC distribution systems are commonly connected to a relatively weak power system compared to HVDC systems, which will decrease the stability of the grid connected converter. Therefore, extra attention should be paid to the converter impedance design as well as the controller parameter in order to increase the stability margin. This paper focuses on the widely used modular multilevel converter (MMC). By conducting the impedance-based stability analysis, this paper firstly deducts the small signal impedance of the grid connected converter in the synchronous rotating frame (i.e. dq0 coordinates), then defines the simplified stability margin and illustrates the influence to it brought by system impedance, converter impedance and the control parameters. Finally, the proposed methodology is verified by both of simulation and a ±10kV MMC prototype. The results have the extensive applicability and practical significance to both the commercial and experimental design.

articleTitle: Effect of temperature and polarity reversal time on transient electric field distribution of XLPE cable joint
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The internal electric field distribution of XLPE HVDC cable joint is affected by temperature and polarity reversal time under polarity reversal voltage. COMSOL Multiphysics is used to obtain the transient electric field distribution of the cable joint fabricated with the silicone rubber as reinforced insulation. Under the polarity reversal voltage, maximum electric field strength of inner side of XLPE and end of high-voltage shielding tube is larger than that of steady state. Transient maximum field strength of two positions decreases with the increase of temperature difference. Temperature changes the electrical conductivities of insulating materials and affects the accumulation of space charge, thus changing the maximum transient electric field strength. During voltage polarity reversal, there is no obvious charge accumulation at the root of stress cone. As temperature rises, the maximum transient electric field strength of stress cone root slightly increases, which is much lower than that of XLPE and high-voltage shielding tube end. In addition, as the polarity reversal time increases, the transient maximum electric field strength of XLPE and high-voltage shielding tube end decreases, while the field strength of stress cone root is basically unaffected.

articleTitle: Research on active power control technology of large-scale renewable energy cluster integrated by VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: VSC-HVDC transmission technology is an effective technology to realize large-scale renewable energy transmission under the condition of weak power grid. For large-scale renewable energy cluster with the VSC-HVDC transmission system as the only transmission path, active power control system is essential to guarantee the operating status of sending terminal converter station within its feasible PQ range. Aiming at the rigid constraint of sending terminal converter station, a radical active power control strategy and a conservative one are proposed in this paper, based on the understanding of the over load risk and operation demand. Ultra-short term power prediction is introduced as a classification index in order to improve the accuracy of generation right dynamic redistribution. On this basis, a method to determine the active power control margin of large-scale renewable energy cluster based on sequential production simulation is proposed. The simulation analysis is carried out based on the example of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC power grid and its renewable energy collection. Results show that the radical active power control strategy needs to reserve more control margin, but the generation space is more fully utilized under this strategy, making the utilization hours of renewable energy stations much higher. The research results of this paper may provide an important reference for the active power control and safety margin setting of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC power grid.

articleTitle: Water absorption, low-molecular dissolution and moisture-induced electrical properties of liquid silicone rubber
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Liquid silicone rubber (LSR) is often used as insulating material of large-scale composite insulators. However, water intrusion will seriously affect its performance. Therefore, studies on the water absorption characteristics of LSR is of great significance. The research object is two series of LSR, with the contents of components A and B as variables. Through constant temperature water absorption test, moisture measurement test, infrared spectrum analysis and electrical tests, the effect of temperature on the water absorption characteristics and the influence of moisture on the electrical properties of LSR were studied. Results show that water diffusion and dissolution of small molecules exist simultaneously in the process of water absorption of LSR, the mass change depends on whether dissolution or absorption dominates. Both the water content and the dissolution mass of small molecules increase with increasing temperature, but the degree of increase is different. The saturated mass change increases first and then decreases with increasing temperature. It can be confirmed that free water and bound water both exist in samples, and small molecules are dissolved out through infrared spectrum analysis. The electrical performance deteriorates with the increase of water absorption.

articleTitle: Electric field analysis of basin-type insulators used in HVDC gil considering surface charge accumulation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The problem of surface charge accumulation is a bottleneck for the development of DC gas insulated transmission line (GIL). In order to solve this problem, many researchers have proposed the mechanism of surface charge accumulation and investigated the various insulators by numerical simulation. Considering the dynamic processes of charge generation, transport and accumulation, this paper carried out the simulation of surface charge and electric field distribution of the basin-type insulator used in high voltage direct current (HVDC) GIL, and the basin-type insulators with three different structures were analysed and compared. The results show that positive charge accumulates on the convex surface of the insulator, while negative charge accumulates on the concave surface. Surface charge will enhance or weaken the electric field in the certain regions. The structure of the basin-type insulator will obviously influence the characteristics of surface charge and electric field on the convex and concave surfaces of the insulator. The more suitable structure for the basin-type insulator used in HVDC GIL was proposed in this paper. The results of this study could provide references for designing insulation structure and reducing surface charge of the basin-type insulators used in HVDC GIL.

articleTitle: Study on discharge characteristics of floating foreign matters on overhead transmission lines
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The transmission line passes through the forest, farmland, human gathering place and other complex environment, which makes the transmission lines face the threat of foreign matter invasion. The plastic cloth overlapped on the conductor is easy to cause the transmission line flashover in rainy weather. In order to study the influence of the geometry size and lapping mode of the plastic cloth on its discharge characteristics under different conductivity of rain water, the surface equivalent salt deposit density, no soluble deposit density of the plastic cloth and the resistance under different conductivity of rainwater were measured, and its conductivity was analysed. The discharge characteristics of plastic cloth under different conductivity of rain water, geometry size and lapping mode were studied, and the discharge process was observed by UV imager. It is found that the old plastic cloth has good conductivity. With the increase of the conductivity of rain water and the width of plastic cloth, the flashover voltage of the plastic cloth decreases gradually. In serious cases, the effective value of flashover voltage of the plastic cloth completely overlapped transmission line is 0.38 kV/cm.

articleTitle: A feed-forward control strategy of virtual synchronous generator under non-ideal grid
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator technology (VSG), which simulates the electro-mechanical transient characteristics of synchronous generators, enables the power supply or load that adopt a converter with a number of its external characteristics, including inertia, damping, frequency and voltage regulation. However, when the grid voltage is not ideal, the traditional VSG control will lead to unbalanced three-phase grid-connected current, so a control method of specific sub-voltage component feed-forward is proposed. First of all, the problems of VSG in non-ideal grid voltage are analysed. Based on this, the harmonic components are extracted by sinusoidal amplitude integral method, and the control strategy of specific voltage component feed-forward is proposed, which can suppress the grid voltage’s negative sequence components and harmonic components. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control strategy is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Research on electrical capacitance tomography technology used in the insulation detection of power cable joints
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The XLPE cable is widely used in AC / DC power transmission, but its joints and other accessories lack of effective quality assessment means after manufacture, which may lead to potential insulation defects. Therefore, it is of great engineering significance to apply electrical capacitance tomography (ECT) technology to the insulation detection of cable joints. In this paper, the finite element software COMSOL is used to establish the model of cable joint and capacitive sensor, and the insulation detection is investigated by simulation. Firstly, the capacitance is measured to calculate the sensitive field, that is the influence of the spatial distribution of the dielectric constant on the capacitance. It is expected that after the sensitivity field distribution is obtained, LBP algorithm is used to calculate the distribution of dielectric constant, and image reconstructions are successfully realized for two kinds of insulation defects in the cable. In the future, an experimental instrument will be built up to detect the insulation of cable joints.

articleTitle: An acceleration algorithm for junction semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to study the failure of high voltage converter module when it is swithed, such as LCC converter module and MMC one, its internal characteristics, carrier migration and composite process are researched in this paper, considering the heat effect, to optimize design of devices and study the mechanism of internal failure and oscillation, like commutation failure. And the switching process of the device is the difficulty in the research, especially the turn-off process. With the continuous increase of the voltage level and internal structure’s complexity, semiconductor devices new challenges are presented for the numerical calculation. A dynamic and static simulation model of PiN diode is established in this paper. The static iterative method and dynamic iterative algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the computing time with the premise of ensuring the original accuracy, which meets the current high voltage level and large time scale computing requirements of power electronic devices. The improved algorithm results are compared with the conventional ones, and the simulation software is used to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, and the proposed method is also suitable for high dimensional junction semiconductor devices successfully.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PI optimal control of MMC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In recent years, MMC-HVDC (high-voltage direct current transmission that based on modular multi-level converter) is the key research direction of China's power system. In order to optimize the control strategy of MMC-HVDC system, the fuzzy PI controller is designed by combining fuzzy control and PI (proportional integral) control,that realize the function of real-time adjustment of PI parameters. The simulation model of the double-ended active 31-level MMC-HVDC system was built by using MATLAB/Simulink simulation software which can compare the simulation waveforms between the traditional PI controller and fuzzy PI controller.As a result, the fuzzy PI controller can effectively improve the transient response characteristics and robustness of the double-ended active MMC-HVDC system and can improve the power quality at the same time.

articleTitle: Reduced-order modelling method for a three-phase high-gain DC–DC converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: As a DC energy conversion interface, the three-phase high-gain DC–DC converter is more suitable for high-gain applications such as grid connection of photovoltaic and energy storage than traditional Boost converter. However, the high-gain converter is a six-order system, which makes controller difficult to design. Due to the coupling relation among the capacitors, traditional series-parallel method and average-switch model method cannot simplify high-gain converter model directly. To solve the above issue, model simplify methods based on average equivalent circuit and state space equation are proposed to reduce system order of the high-gain converter. Correctness of the reduced-order model is verified by two simplification methods each other, which are studied in more detail in this paper. Closed-loop control of the three-phase high-gain converter is designed by using reduced-order model. Finally, closed-loop operation characteristics of the high-gain converter with load suddenly increase and decrease are implemented by simulation and experiment, which proves the validity and feasibility of the proposed order reduced modelling method.

articleTitle: Research on the effects of different DC filter configurations in ±1100kV UHVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Due to the uneven distribution of energy and electricity load in China, ultra-high-voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system is widely used because of its large transmission capacity and not limited by distance. DC filter, as an important equipment of UHVDC transmission system, will directly affect the safety and stability of UHVDC system. So it is important to study the steady-state and transient processes with different DC filter configurations in the power system. Based on ±1100kV UHVDC transmission project, this paper builds the simulation model with hierarchical connection mode by the EMTDC/PSCAD simulation software, including the control logic. The simulation analysis was first carried out in steady-state operation. For the cases of configuring dual-tuned, triple-tuned and no DC filter configuration, the differences in steady state are mainly reflected in filtering effect. Through Fourier decomposition, the three-tuned filter has the best filtering effect. Next, the simulation was undertaken when typical faults occur on the different DC filters in the unipolar-ground return line, unipolar-metal return line and bipolar operation modes, respectively. Finally, simulation waveforms and corresponding overvoltage characteristics are summarised in this study. The results show that in the transient state, by Changji-Guquan UHVDC transmission system. The effects of different DC filter configurations are studied. By comparing the filtering effect in the steady-state and the electromagnetic process under the typical fault, the most suitable configuration of DC filter is proposed.

articleTitle: Passivity-based control strategy of MMCHVDC with wind farm based on ESO and TSMC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With the depletion of fossil fuels such as Petroleum, new energy sources have received more attentions. The DFIG wind farm connected to the grid by MMC-HVDC (Modular Multilevel Converter, CMMC) system has become an important means to solve the problem of new energy consumption. The traditional double closed-loop control can not improve the low inertia problem of wind farm and flexible DC system. In order to solve this problem, Firstly, the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) controller of the wind farm side MMC inverter is designed. Secondly, in order to reduce the influence of parameters on VSG and improve its transient and steady state performance, an additional frequency control based on extended state observer (ESO) and terminal sliding mode control (TSMC) is introduced in the VSG frequency controller, and the stability of the controller is proved. Finally, a simulation model of the DFIG connected to the MMC-HVDC is built in Matlab/Simulink. Through simulation analysis, the effectiveness of the Passivity-based Controller to improve the frequency and voltage stability under transient conditions is verified.

articleTitle: Pilot protection scheme of flexible DC transmission line based on correlation coefficient
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: In order to deal with the pole to pole fault of DC transmission line, this paper presents a protection method based on current limiting inductance. In this scheme, the current limiting reactor is used as the boundary element, and the correlation criterion is constructed by the first derivative of current and voltage of the current limiting reactance to distinguish the faults inside and outside the region. Under the specified reference direction, when there is fault in the line area, the inductive voltage and current at both ends of the line are the related reference directions, and the correlation coefficient symbols are the same. In case of external fault, the far fault point inductive voltage and current are the related reference directions, while the near fault point inductive voltage and current are the non-related reference directions, and the correlation coefficient symbols are opposite. According to this difference, a protection scheme is constructed to identify the fault. The scheme uses the electric quantity at both ends and is not affected by the transition resistance. A large number of simulation experiments show that the scheme can accurately identify faults inside and outside the region.

articleTitle: Research on transient voltage caused by circuit breakers switching off high voltage shunt reactors
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: For substations which used to gather new energies, or for the middle of a long transmission line, and for the receiving end with intensive loads, the network needs high voltage(HV) shunt reactors applied to lower voltage of the bus, which puts forward new demands for the insulation level of the HV shunt reactors, and capacity of nearby main equipment such as capacitive voltage transformer(CVT). In this paper, the mechanism of transient voltage of switching off HV shunt reactor connected to AC bus was explained. The influence factors, which included capacity of HV shunt reactors, current chopping, reignition, substation arrangement methods, were considered during the simulation. Although the transient voltage amplitude during the operation was high, its oscillation frequency reached at the range of lighting overvoltage, and its insulation level should be considered according to the lightning impulse of the equipment. To solve the problem of high amplitude and frequency of CVT current caused by the transient voltage, restraining measures were discussed and analysed. The results of this paper can provide timely and scientific reference and basis for project design and operation.

articleTitle: Single-Ended Current Differential Protection for Pole-to-ground Fault in MMC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Protection is one of the most challenging issues for the modular multilevel converter based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) system. The pole-to-ground fault is a typical fault of MMC-HVDC system. This paper proposes a novel protection scheme for the pole-to-ground fault based on the single-ended differential current (SEDC), which is the difference between positive pole current and negative pole current at the same end. The characteristics of SEDC are theoretically analyzed for pole-to-ground fault, pole-to-pole fault and AC faults, and these characteristics are used to construct the protection scheme. A 200 kV MMC-HVDC simulation system is modeled in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the performance of the proposed protection. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed protection scheme can correctly distinguish the pole-to-ground fault from other faults and select the faulted line under different fault conditions.

articleTitle: Electric field calculation and optimization of dc vertical disconnector in ±500kV valve hall
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC disconnector is one of the key equipment in valve hall, consisting of hoop, fixed contact, moving contact, folding mechanism, post insulator, pedestal and shielding ring. Because of the complex structure of disconnector, severe electric distortion was likely to occur in this part. Thus analysing the potential and electric field distribution of the equipment was necessary. In this paper, a model of a one-column-vertical telescopic disconnector in ±500kV valve hall was established and calculated using finite-element method software COMSOL. The surface electric field of the opening and closing disconnector was calculated separately and compared with the critical value of the electric field (20kV/cm). According to the calculation results, the structure parameters of disconnector were adjusted in some aspects. After the optimization, the maximum surface field strength in closing condition appearing at the bottom of pedestal was 18.5kV/cm and the maximum surface field strength in opening condition appearing at the shielding ring of hoops was 19.2kV/cm. The calculation results could provide valuable references for the design of DC disconnector in ±500kV valve hall.

articleTitle: Assessment of performance for power system operation with renewable energy
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Operational and reliability problems may rise when a large amount of wind and solar power penetrate into power system, due to the characteristics such as volatility and randomness of these renewable energies. In order to assess the operation status and reliability of the hybrid power system, it is very important to establish a set of indices to evaluate the performance of the hybrid power system operation. In this paper, firstly, the existing indices are analysed. Then, three new indices such as output offset rate, output offset coefficient and output relative coefficient are proposed for measuring the power output. Finally, the proposed method with three new indices is used to analyse the power output of the wind-solar hybrid system in the specified time period. The results show that the proposed indices have great practical significance and outstanding simplicity, and can effectively evaluate the operation status of the hybrid power system comparing with the traditional indices.

articleTitle: Research status of insulation performance of high voltage converter transformer bushing
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The high voltage capacitor filled SF6 gas bushing is an important equipment to realize the electrical connection between the converter transformer and the valve tower. The paper mainly analyzes current status of the research on its insulation performance. Firstly, the characteristics of harsh operation conditions and complicated E-field distribution of converter transformer bushing are analyzed. The development and research status of the converter bushing are also discussed in detail. Finally, the research direction of the converter bushing is presented. Summary research shows: the high current and the high voltage operating environment put forward the higher requirements for the design of insulation structure of converter transformer bushing. It is subjected to AC and DC superposition and polarity reversal electrical stress for a long time. Therefore, the insulation property of the epoxy paper composite material, the establishment of the heat transfer model of the bushing, the design of the main insulation structure and the nonlinear electric field simulation of the outlet device are all the promising research directions. The results of this paper can provide some technical support for the insulation design of HVDC transmission engineering, and point out the research direction and theoretical guidance for the domestic development and engineering application of the high voltage converter transformer bushing.

articleTitle: A method of suppressing overcurrent in DC microgrid based on virtual impedance
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: DC microgrid is an important part of the future smart distribution networks. Compared with AC microgrid, DC microgrid can efficiently connect distributed renewable energy sources, energy storage units, electric vehicles and DC loads. The short-circuit current of the microgrid is mainly provided by the branch with energy sources such as PVs and lead to an overcurrent in the microgrid. This paper proposes a fault current active suppression method based on virtual impedance. The fault characteristics of DC microgrid under bipolar fault is studied in the paper. The proposed method can suppress overcurrent during a fault and reduce the effect of overcurrent on DC microgrid protection. A DC microgrid model with AC/DC power supply is established in the paper to simulate the proposed method. The simulation results show that the method is effective on suppressing overcurrent from photovoltaic power generation and the AC power grid branch during a fault. The proposed method has the potential to be used in the real engineering project.

articleTitle: CNN based accurate fault location method in distribution network
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With higher power quality requirement of users, power companies pay more attention to the improvement of distribution network. To decrease outage time, accurate fault location algorithm has been widely used in transmission network, but faces with plenty of difficulties when it comes to distribution network. DC lines and distributed generations, such as wind turbine and photovoltaic generation, make distribution network increasingly complex. This paper introduces a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based accurate fault location method in distribution network with Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) information. Besides, the performance of proposed method when memory or communication failures happen is discussed. The precisely-synchronized curves recorded by the PMUs are fed into CNN. The curves with pre- and post-fault data can offer abundant features which is hard to extract for traditional methods. In our experiments, the result proves that the proposed method has a good performance not only with complete PMU information but also with incomplete PMU information.

articleTitle: Research about the thermoelectric coupling of insulator surface dry band and COMSOL simulation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Suspension insulator surface dry band will greatly change the surface thermoelectric field distribution, resulting in strong local field, the sharing of potential, too high temperature rising, so it will affect the stability of the normal operation of the insulator. In this paper, the influence factors of polyphysical states of the insulator after dry band formation is studied. COMSOL software was used to study the effect of different pollution levels on the surface thermoelectric field distribution of suspension insulators, and the change of the number and location of insulator surface dry band to maximum field strength were discussed. Simulation results show that the steel foot has high potential, while the electric potential of the gooses is low, moreover the pollution levels influence of dry band on the potential has a cut-off point. The temperatures of the steel foot and goosan are high, while the temperatures of the remaining parts are low, and the heat is collected to the goosan and the dry band. The strength of the electric field near the steel foot is high, and the intensity of the electric field near the goosan is small. Compared with reducing the number of dry band, improving the distribution uniformity of dry band is more important to avoid the pollution flashover accident. The results of three-dimension analysis are of practical significance to prevent pollution flashover.

articleTitle: Wide voltage and high gain Dual-Bridge flexible switching anode power supply conversion circuit
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: This paper presents a high gain and wide range dual-bridge flexible switching isolated boost converter. Through the flexible and smooth switching between phase shift control and PWM control applied to the two bridges, the series or parallel combination of the secondary winding of the full-bridge transformer is completed to realize the wide range and high gain output of the converter; at the same time, under the phase shift control mode, all the switches on the primary side of the converter realize the soft switch in a wide range; this paper analyses the working principle, control strategy and characteristics of the converter in detail, then tests them. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed converter and its control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Wide input/output control method for a bidirectional series capacitor high-gain DC–DC converter
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: Series capacitor converter is a kind of high-gain DC-DC converter based on interleaving and paralleling technics. Currently for the n-phase bidirectional series capacitor high-gain DC-DC converter, it still has disadvantages of narrow duty cycle range and narrow input / output voltage range, which make the converter just suitable for the duty cycle range only from (n-1)/n to 1 in the boost mode, and from 0 to 1/n in the buck mode. To achieve wide input / output voltage range and high voltage gain, a novel control method by widening the duty cycle range from 0 to 1 is proposed in this paper. Meanwhile, the automatic current sharing of inductors can also be achieved with the proposed control method. The operating principle, voltage gain, as well as current distribution of inductors with the duty cycle range from 0 to 1 are then analysed and calculated comprehensively. Wide input / output voltage range, corresponding working duty cycle range, voltage gain and current distribution feature are verified by a three-phase bidirectional series capacitor high-gain DC-DC converter prototype experiment.

articleTitle: Frequency stability analysis of high proportion renewable energy system delivered via DC
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The proportion of renewable energy generation in China is gradually increasing, and the energy and load are reversely distributed, so renewable energy accumulation areas need to send power through large-capacity DC. The DC capacity of the send-end system is large, so the DC failure is a serious failure. This paper analyses the frequency variation process of the send-end system during severe faults, points out that the total inertia of the system is the main influencing factor, and gives the calculation method of the frequency changing amount of the send-end system under severe faults. Based on this, it is proposed that adjusting the operation mode and increasing energy storage are feasible methods to enhance the frequency stability under severe faults. They affect the frequency change process by affecting the total inertia of the system and the imbalance power applied to the inertial system, respectively. Finally, our conclusions are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Protection scheme optimization for VSC-HVDC distribution networks
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: VSC-HVDC distribution networks have many advantages compared to AC distribution networks. However, as the fault characteristics of VSC-HVDC distribution networks and its overload capability are significantly different from AC networks, the requirements of the protection operating speed and fault location for VSC-HVDC distribution networks are higher than those for AC networks. Currently the design of the protection scheme for VSC-HVDC distribution networks mainly refers to the protection scheme of VSC-HVDC transmission networks, its main protection normally includes differential protection, instantaneous over-current protection etc. The backup protection normally includes time-delayed over-current protection, over- and under-voltage protection etc, whereas the protection for AC networks is very simple which normally only includes a three-stage over-current protection. This makes the protection scheme of the VSC-HVDC distribution networks complex and expensive to run. This paper studies the protection scheme design for VSC-HVDC distribution networks, it suggests a simplified backup protection scheme for the converter station of VSC-HVDC distribution networks. The coordination method between the main and backup protection are studied. By considering both the reliability and economic requirements, an optimal protection scheme for VSC-HVDC distribution networks is proposed. Simulation study by using PSCAD/EMTDC has been carried out, it is demonstrated that the proposed protection scheme is effective and economical.

articleTitle: NOVEL STRUCTURE OF POWER GRID OF OFFSHORE OIL PLATFORM GROUP
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The stable and safe operation of offshore oil platform power grid is the key to ensure the smooth production of offshore engineering. This paper mainly studies the analysis and description scheme after the system failure under the current structure of offshore oil platform power grid, to ensure that the platform does not lose power for a long time. This paper first introduces the basic structure of the power grid of the offshore oil platform, then introduces the energy management system used for the comprehensive automatic control of the system, then gives the line parameter change curve and the control action of the EMS system when the actual fault occurs, and analyzes it, finally gives the effective treatment scheme when the fault occurs. In this paper, novel structure of offshore oil platform group power grid is discussed, which can be used for reference in the prevention and treatment of power grid of offshore oil platform, and which will be put adopted in the future.

articleTitle: Impedance modeling and analysis of VSC-based HVDC system considering frequency coupling effects
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: This paper develops an impedance-based small-signal model for the two-terminal VSC-based HVDC system. At first, the recent developments of impedance models of the converters involving mirrored frequency coupling effects are presented. Then, the small-signal perturbation-response characteristics of HVDC system are investigated, considering the frequency coupling effects of both the rectifier and inverter, as well as the dynamics of the DC-link. Based on that, a new sequence impedance model that consists of eight transfer functions is proposed for the whole HVDC system, which can not only represent the perturbation-response characteristics at each terminal, but also the transfer characteristics between the two terminals. Finally, the application of the new model for the modeling of complex multi-converter system is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the optimal allocation of regional IES based on homer
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: As an important physical carrier of Energy Internet, regional integrated energy system is one of great significance to improve the efficiency of comprehensive energy utilization, eliminate renewable energy, ensure the safety and reliability of energy supply, save energy and reduce emissions. At present, most of the existing research focuses on the optimal scheduling problem and single energy planning problem of multi-energy system, but few systematic and detailed evaluation of the optimal allocation of multiple energy forms in multi-energy system is carried out. Therefore, this paper analyzes the power supply and heating characteristics of various equipment in the integrated system of wind energy, hydropower and cogeneration in multi-energy advantage area, and then analyzes the economic indexes of each component and system as a whole. And a comprehensive evaluation research is carried out on the three indexes of the energy consumption index and the environmental index, and the optimal configuration scheme of the optimal wind power unit and the cogeneration unit is obtained.

articleTitle: Research of digital twin in power system optimization–take offshore platform for example
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With more and more data collected in the offshore platform production, the application of digital twins (DT) in the power grid can realize the data feedback to the digital model concurrently, and realize a high degree of uniformity between the prediction model and the actual physical system based on the exchange of data. On this basis, an accurate digital modeling description of the actual physical process can be accomplished, so that the load can be optimized and scheduled more accurately. In this paper, a micro grid of oilfield platforms is taken as the research object. The load forecasting, fault analysis and power system optimization of offshore oilfield platforms is hard in traditional models. This paper uses the (phasor measurement unit) PMU for situation awareness and update actual time data thus the digital model can receive feedback from actual situation. A DT model based on data collected and uploaded by sensors and the PMU is proposed as a digital model on the cloud. On this basis, this loop forms an adaptive and self-learning system which can minimize the forecast error and obtain better optimization. The DT model can make the design and update of offshore oilfield platforms power system easier, as well as cut down the cost of optimization.

articleTitle: Research on voltage drop of test transformer during combined voltage test
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: The combined voltage test on open switching device is one of the most important dielectric test of high voltage switchgear. During the impulse combined voltage test, due to capacitance coupling between the two high voltage power source, there will be a certain voltage drop on test transformer at the instant of the peak of the impulse. Appropriate voltage drop compensation measures should be taken to meet the standard’s requirement. This paper briefly discussed the value of peak coefficient of reverse power frequency voltage in combined voltage test. By taking a 1100kV GIS type disconnector’s lightning impulse combined voltage test (LIWV+AC) as an example, through actual test waveform analysis combined with the equivalent circuit calculation and ATP-EMTP simulation, the influence of capacitance across the open switching device and the additional capacitance on voltage drop is mainly studied, and the reasonable test method were also given out. Finally, the problems that should be paid attention to in the actual test are summarized.

articleTitle: Effects of dicumyl peroxide content on DC properties of polystyrene pinning crosslinked polyethylene for potential application in HVDC cable insulation
publicationTitle: The 16th IET International Conference on AC and DC Power Transmission (ACDC 2020)
abstract: With HVDC lines developing towards a higher voltage level and a larger transmission capacity, cables have been a crucial equipment subjected to both electrical and thermal stress. Polystyrene (PS) pinning crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE), a new type of insulating material, shows a great potential to fulfil the requirements of insulating materials for extruded HVDC cables. However, the role of pinning in the interphase area has not been fully understood.
